   flex-shrink:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}\n/* Level-1 group headings on a subject page ("Bookkeeping and statements", "Cost and\n   variance analysis", ...). A trailing control — the Close button that a tile\n   group carries inside its heading — is parked at the far right ON the rule, so a group\n   heading reads the same whether or not it has a button, and the bar and the rule still\n   form one continuous line. */\n.levelhead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;position:relative;\n  margin:26px 0 12px;padding:0 0 7px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);\n  font-size:13.4px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--text-3);\n  font-weight:600}\n.levelhead::before{content:"";flex:0 0 auto;width:4px;height:1.05em;border-radius:2px;\n  background:var(--green-600)}\n.levelhead > button:first-of-type{margin-left:auto}\n.levelhead > button{margin-left:8px}\n.levelhead > button + button{margin-left:8px}\n\n/* Every subject page: a filled band across the full content width instead of a marker.\n   White on --green-700 (#076B41) is about 7.5:1 — WCAG AA and AAA for a label this\n   size; --green-600 would be 3.1:1 and fails, so the darker green is deliberate. */\n#subjectout .levelhead{\n  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;\n  background:var(--green-700);color:#fff;border-bottom:0;border-radius:8px;\n  padding:9px 12px;margin:22px 0 14px;font-size:13.2px;letter-spacing:.08em}\n#subjectout .levelhead::before{display:none}\n\n/* A control that belongs to a heading (the Close on a tile group) becomes part of the\n   bar: it sits in a right-hand action zone, separated by a soft rule, as a 26 px square\n   icon in white. Calculator</span><span class="railtip">Business Calculator: launch any financial or business calculation the engine supports</span>\n      </a>\n    </div>\n  </nav>\n\n  <main id="main">\n    <section class="panel" id="panel-home" aria-labelledby="home-title">\n      <div class="hero">\n        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="">\n        <h1 id="home-title">Smart Business <span class="g">Writer</span></h1>\n        <p class="slogan"><span class="slogan-lead">Your reliable business writing assistant</span><br><span class="slogan-proof">Real computation. Real research. Built for business students.</span></p>\n      </div>\n      <div class="actionbox">\n        <label class="visually-hidden" for="objective">What would you like to work on?</label>\n        <textarea id="objective" placeholder="What would you like to work on..."></textarea>\n        <div class="row" style="margin:2px 0 8px;gap:8px;align-items:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap">\n          <label class="field" for="homelength" style="margin:0;max-width:320px">Report length\n            <select id="homelength">\n              <option value="">Short (600-1,200 words)</option>\n              <option value="mid">Mid (1,200-2,500 words)</option>\n              <option value="long">Long (2,500-5,000 words)</option>\n            </select>\n          </label>\n          <span class="muted" style="padding-bottom:6px">Short is enough for many cases; mid adds the evidence base and discussion, long adds the full analysis.</span>\n        </div>\n        <div class="actionrow">\n          <button class="btn" id="attachbtn" type="button" title="Attach files for this analysis">Attach files</button>\n          <input type="file" id="attachfile" multiple hidden>\n          <!-- Legacy hooks, never shown. The framework is inferred from the brief; the\n               strings are kept only because the pinned UI test asserts these two ids\n               (tests/** is the computation owner\'s lane). Retire them together. -->\n          <select id="chatframework" hidden aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">\n            <option value="">Infer from the brief</option>\n            <option value="pestel">PESTEL</option>\n            <option value="swot">SWOT</option>\n            <option value="pestel_swot">PESTEL + SWOT</option>\n            <option value="five_forces">Five Forces</option>\n            <option value="five_forces_breakeven">Five Forces + Break-even</option>\n          </select>\n          <button type="button" id="chatstart" hidden tabindex="-1">Start the analysis</button>\n          <button class="runbtn" id="run" type="button" aria-label="Start the analysis" title="Start the analysis (Enter)">\n            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 19V5M6 11l6-6 6 6"/></svg>\n          </button>\n        </div>\n        <div id="attachments" class="attachments" aria-live="polite"></div>\n      </div>\n      <div class="card" id="chatcard" hidden>\n        <div id="chatout" aria-live="polite"></div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n\n    <!-- The chat lives on the Home page now. This section is kept, hidden and never\n         rendered, only so an old #/chat link still resolves (the router sends it to\n         Home). Remove it once the pinned UI test no longer asserts the id. -->\n    <section class="panel" id="panel-chat" hidden></section>\n\n    <section class="panel" id="panel-plan" hidden aria-labelledby="plan-title">\n      <div class="card">\n        <h2 id="plan-title">Business plan</h2>\n        <div id="planout"></div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n\n    <section class="panel" id="panel-subjects" hidden aria-labelledby="subjects-title">\n      <div class="card">\n        <h2 id="subjects-title">All subjects</h2>\n        <p class="sub">Every subject in the rail, mapped to the calculations and worksheets the engine actually supports.\n          Open a subject to see its capabilities as tiles, the stored cases that used them, and an explicit catalogue-only section.</p>\n        <div id="subjectgallery"></div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n\n    <section class="panel" id="panel-subject" hidden aria-labelledby="subject-title">\n      <div class="card">\n        <h2 id="subject-title">Subject</h2>\n        <div id="subjectout"></div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n\n    <section class="panel" id="panel-portfolio" hidden aria-labelledby="portfolio-title">\n      <div id="portfolioout"></div>\n    </section>\n\n    <section class="panel" id="panel-calculator" hidden aria-labelledby="calculator-title">\n      <div class="card">\n        <h2 id="calculator-title">Business Calculator</h2>\n        <p class="sub">Launch a frozen financial or business calculation. The Business Calculator arranges the inputs and calls\n          the same method the subject page uses; <strong>it computes nothing itself</strong>.</p>\n        <div id="calcnote"></div>\n        <details class="studynote" id="calclimits">\n          <summary>What it can\'t do</summary>\n          <p class="muted">This is every calculation the engine actually holds, not every calculation a business course names. It runs a recorded method and returns that method\'s delivery; it computes nothing in the page.</p>\n          <ul>\n            <li><strong>Bare arithmetic</strong> - <code>2 + 2</code> or <code>15% of 84,000</code> is not enabled. Pressing <code>=</code> runs a declared method, never an expression.</li>\n            <li><strong>Tax law</strong> - tax is computed only from rates you declare; no jurisdiction\'s credits, thresholds or filing rules are applied.</li>\n            <li><strong>Market data</strong> - no share prices or market forecasts. A trend forecast uses the series you supply.</li>\n            <li><strong>Advice</strong> - the engine values the cash flows and figures you declare; it does not recommend a loan, an investment or a purchase.</li>\n          </ul>\n        </details>\n        <div class="calcbar">\n          <label class="visually-hidden" for="calcq">Search the Business Calculator</label>\n          <input type="search" id="calcq" placeholder="Search a calculation (NPV, WACC, break-even, t-test, ...)">\n          <div class="toggle" role="group" aria-label="Input mode">\n            <button id="calcmode-pad" type="button" aria-pressed="true">Keypad</button>\n            <button id="calcmode-ask" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Ask instead</button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <div id="calcchat" hidden>\n          <div class="calcbar">\n            <label class="visually-hidden" for="calcask">Ask the Business Calculator</label>\n            <input type="text" id="calcask" placeholder="e.g. break-even with 1200 fixed cost, price 20, variable 12">\n            <button class="btn primary" id="calcaskgo" type="button">Ask</button>\n            <button class="btn" id="calcmode-back" type="button">Back to the keypad</button>\n          </div>\n          <p class="muted">Ask in words or type the figures. The sentence becomes a plan you confirm; nothing is calculated here.</p>\n          <div id="calcchatout"></div>\n        </div>\n        <div class="chips" id="calcgroups" style="justify-content:flex-start;margin-top:0"></div>\n        <div class="calcgrid" id="calcgrid" hidden>\n          <div>\n            <div class="calcdisplay">\n              <div class="line" id="calcline" aria-live="polite"></div>\n              <div class="unit" id="calcunit"></div>\n              <div class="said" id="calcsaid"></div>\n            </div>\n            <div class="calcpad" id="calcpad" role="group" aria-label="Calculator keypad"></div>\n            <p class="calcpadnote" id="calcpadnote"></p>\n          </div>\n          <div>\n            <div class="row" style="justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start">\n              <div><h3 id="calcname" style="margin:0"></h3><p class="muted" id="calcwhat" style="margin:4px 0 0"></p></div>\n              <span class="badge" id="calctier"></span>\n            </div>\n            <div class="grid2" id="calcinputs" style="margin-top:12px"></div>\n            <div class="row" style="margin-top:14px">\n              <button class="btn primary" id="calceq" type="button">= Calculate and record</button>\n              <button class="btn" id="calcreset" type="button">Clear</button>\n              <button class="btn" id="calcback" type="button">Back to the list</button>\n            </div>\n            <div id="calcresult"></div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <div id="calcout"></div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n\n    <section class="panel" id="panel-results" hidden aria-labelledby="results-title">\n      <div class="card">\n        <h2 id="results-title">Result</h2>\n        <div class="report"></div>\n        <div class="row">\n          <button class="btn primary" id="savecase" type="button">Save as case</button>\n          <button class="btn" id="tocharts" type="button" hidden>Charts and exports</button>\n          <button class="btn" id="tostats" type="button">Download financial statements</button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n\n    <section class="panel" id="panel-cases" hidden aria-labelledby="cases-title">\n      <div class="card">\n        <h2 id="cases-title">Cases</h2>\n        <div class="tablewrap"><table><caption>Stored cases</caption><thead><tr>\n          <th>Title</th><th>Method</th><th>Tier</th><th>Created</th><th>Close</th></tr></thead><tbody></tbody></table></div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n\n    <section class="panel" id="panel-case" hidden aria-labelledby="case-title">\n      <div class="card">\n        <h2 id="case-title">Case</h2>\n        <div class="tabs" role="tablist">\n          <button class="tab" role="tab" data-tab="report" aria-selected="true">Report</button>\n          <button class="tab" role="tab" data-tab="versions" aria-selected="false">Versions</button>\n          <button class="tab" role="tab" data-tab="comparison" aria-selected="false">Comparison</button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n\n    <section class="panel" id="panel-data" hidden aria-labelledby="data-title">\n      <div class="card">\n        <h2 id="data-title">Data ingestion (structured files)</h2>\n        <p class="sub">Read a CSV/TSV or XLSX file into a typed table with a provenance pointer. Post the file to\n          <code>/api/ingest</code>. PDF, scans and SPSS files are refused: <strong>no PDF text extraction or OCR</strong>\n          is implemented.</p>\n        <div class="row">\n          <input type="file" id="ingfile" accept=".csv,.tsv,.txt,.xlsx,.xlsm">\n          <button class="btn primary" id="ingestbtn" type="button">Ingest file</button>\n        </div>\n        <div id="ingout"></div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n\n    <section class="panel" id="panel-refs" hidden aria-labelledby="refs-title">\n      <div class="card">\n        <h2 id="refs-title">References (optional)</h2>\n        <p class="sub">The title and DOI are sent to the selected bibliographic API\n          (<code>/api/literature/sources</code>). No case text is sent.</p>\n        <div class="row">\n          <input type="text" id="refdoi" placeholder="DOI (optional, e.g. 10.1000/example)">\n          <input type="text" id="reftitle" placeholder="Title">\n          <select id="refsrc"><option value="auto">auto</option></select>\n          <button class="btn primary" id="verify" type="button">Verify reference</button>\n          <label class="field" style="margin:0">Citation style\n            <select id="refstyle"><option value="apa">APA 7</option><option value="harvard">Harvard</option></select>\n          </label>\n          <button class="btn" id="cite" type="button">Get citation</button>\n        </div>\n        <div id="refout"></div>\n        <div class="row" style="margin-top:14px">\n          <button class="btn" id="showlog" type="button">Show retrieval log</button>\n          <button class="btn" id="drift" type="button">Check drift</button>\n        </div>\n        <div id="reflog"></div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n\n    <section class="panel" id="panel-deliver" hidden aria-labelledby="deliver-title">\n      <div class="card">\n        <h2 id="deliver-title">Deliverables</h2>\n        <div id="delout"></div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n\n    <section class="panel" id="panel-accounts" hidden aria-labelledby="accounts-title">\n      <div class="card">\n        <h2 id="accounts-title">Accounts</h2>\n        <div id="acctout"></div>\n      </div>\n      <div class="card">\n        <h2>Account mapping</h2>\n        <div id="acctmap" class="muted">No mapping yet.</div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n\n    <section class="panel" id="panel-status" hidden aria-labelledby="status-title">\n      <div class="card">\n        <h2 id="status-title">Status</h2>\n        <div id="statusout"></div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n\n    <section class="panel" id="panel-check" hidden aria-labelledby="check-title">\n      <div class="card">\n        <h2 id="check-title">Check my trial balance</h2>\n        <p class="muted">Paste your trial balance straight from Excel: one account per line, with its debit or\n          credit. Nothing is calculated on this page &mdash; the engine compares what you give it with the\n          trial balance your own journal produces, and tells you where the two disagree.</p>\n        <label class="field" for="tbinput">Your trial balance &mdash; account, debit, credit (tab, comma or semicolon)</label>\n        <textarea id="tbinput" rows="12" spellcheck="false" placeholder="Cash&#9;1500&#9;&#10;Capital&#9;&#9;1500"></textarea>\n        <div class="row" style="margin-top:10px">\n          <button class="btn primary" id="checkrun" type="button">Check</button>\n          <button class="btn" id="checkdemo" type="button">Use an example</button>\n          <button class="btn" id="checkclear" type="button">Clear</button>\n        </div>\n        <p class="muted" style="margin-top:10px">With only a trial balance I can check that it balances and is\n          internally consistent. That is the weakest check in accounting: errors of principle, commission,\n          original entry, omission, reversal and compensating errors all leave a trial balance balanced.</p>\n      </div>\n      <div id="checkout"></div>\n    </section>\n  </main>\n</div>\n\n<button class="chatbtn" id="chatbtn" type="button" aria-label="Help and about">\n  <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="">\n</button>\n\n<aside class="drawer" id="drawer" hidden aria-labelledby="drawer-title">\n  <header>\n    <h2 id="drawer-title" style="margin:0;font-size:19px">Help &amp; about</h2>\n    <span class="grow"></span>\n    <button class="btn sm ghost" id="drawerclose" type="button">Close</button>\n  </header>\n  <div class="body">\n    <div id="dhelp">\n      <h3>What this is</h3>\n      <p class="sub">A local workbench that calls the local API. Every number shown is computed by the method library\n        and printed exactly as the server returned it. Nothing is calculated in the browser.</p>\n      <h3>How it works</h3>\n      <p class="sub">Describe the case in the box on Home and press the arrow. The chat asks only what it still\n        needs, proposes a plan you confirm, then finds the evidence and drafts the section.<br>\n        Figures come from the subject rail or the Business Calculator: pick a subject, enter your numbers, and\n        the method library computes the answer with its checks, its limits and an export you can submit.<br>\n        Every number is computed by the method library and printed exactly as the server returned it. Nothing is\n        calculated in the browser.</p>\n      <h3>Which one do I need?</h3>\n      <p class="sub"><strong>Guided paper</strong> for a full PESTEL, SWOT or combined paper with sources.\n        <strong>Subjects</strong> for one topic and its tools, such as break-even or a ratio.\n        <strong>Business Calculator</strong> for one calculation.\n        <strong>Business plan</strong> for the plan sections and financial blocks.\n        <strong>Portfolio</strong> for a dated valuation of your holdings and prices.\n        <strong>Check</strong> for a trial balance against your journal.</p>\n      <p class="sub">Every subject page has a <strong>Student guide</strong> with a Start here path, what to prepare\n        and what the shelf does not do.</p>\n      <h3>Key words</h3>\n      <ul class="guidesteps">\n        <li><strong>Calculation</strong> — one method with figures you declare.</li>\n        <li><strong>Worked example</strong> — a preset you replace with your own numbers.</li>\n        <li><strong>Checks</strong> — the engine\'s own verification; a failed check blocks the result.</li>\n        <li><strong>T1 / T2</strong> — a standard tool or a custom analysis; the result says which.</li>\n        <li><strong>Blocked</strong> — the engine refused; the reason is shown, and nothing is guessed.</li>\n      </ul>\n      <h3>Offline</h3>\n      <p class="sub">No external network calls, no web fonts, no analytics.</p>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</aside>\n\n<div class="toasts" id="toasts" aria-live="polite"></div>\n\n<div class="modal" id="modal" hidden role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="modaltitle"></div>\n\n<!-- Pricing: a dialog over the workbench. The four plans come from /api/billing/plans, so this\n     markup never holds a price; the credit allowances are null in the catalogue and print as\n     "To be confirmed" until the owner sets them. -->\n<div class="pm" id="pricing" hidden role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="pmtitle">\n  <div class="pm-sheet">\n    <button class="pm-x" type="button" id="pmclose" aria-label="Close">×</button>\n\n    <div class="pm-view" id="pm-plans">\n      <h2 id="pmtitle">Choose your plan</h2>\n      <p class="pm-sub">Every tier runs the same engine. The tiers differ in size, not in honesty.</p>\n      <div class="pm-toggle">\n        <button class="lab on" id="pmlab-m" type="button">Monthly</button>\n        <button class="pm-switch" id="pmswitch" type="button" role="switch" aria-checked="false"\n                aria-label="Bill annually instead of monthly"><i></i></button>\n        <button class="lab" id="pmlab-a" type="button">Annual<span class="pm-save" id="pmsave">Save</span></button>\n      </div>\n      <div class="pm-grid" id="pmgrid"><p class="pm-note">Loading plans…</p></div>\n      <p class="pm-note" id="pmnote"></p>\n    </div>\n\n    <div class="pm-view" id="pm-check" hidden>\n      <div class="pm-check">\n        <div id="pmck-ready">\n          <div class="t" id="pmck-title">—</div>\n          <p id="pmck-copy"></p>\n          <div id="pmslot"></div>\n          <div id="pmloading" style="font-size:14px;color:var(--navy-700);opacity:.6;padding:8px 0">Loading PayPal…</div>\n          <button class="pm-back" type="button" id="pmback">\u2190 Back to plans</button>\n        </div>\n        <div id="pmck-busy" hidden>\n          <div class="pm-busy"></div>\n          <p id="pmbusy">Talking to PayPal…</p>\n        </div>\n        <div id="pmck-done" hidden>\n          <div class="pm-ok">\u2713</div>\n          <div class="t">Subscription active</div>\n          <div class="pm-kv"><span class="k">Plan</span><span class="v" id="pmdone-plan">—</span></div>\n          <div class="pm-kv"><span class="k">Billed</span><span class="v" id="pmdone-bill">—</span></div>\n          <div class="pm-kv"><span class="k">Credits</span><span class="v" id="pmdone-cr">To be confirmed</span></div>\n          <p style="margin-top:10px">Your plan is recorded here. Credits are added by the export wallet\n            once the allowance for this tier is set.</p>\n          <button class="btn primary" type="button" id="pmdone-close" style="width:100%">Done</button>\n        </div>\n        <div id="pmck-fail" hidden>\n          <div class="t">That did not go through</div>\n          <p id="pmfail"></p>\n          <button class="btn primary" type="button" id="pmfail-retry" style="width:100%">Try again</button>\n          <button class="pm-back" type="button" id="pmfail-back">\u2190 Back to plans</button>\n        </div>\n        <div id="pmck-config" hidden>\n          <div class="t">Checkout is not switched on</div>\n          <p id="pmconfig"></p>\n          <button class="pm-back" type="button" id="pmconfig-back">\u2190 Back to plans</button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n\n<script>\n"use strict";\nconst MARK = "data:image/png;base64,";\n/* Smart BusinessWriter workbench - presentation only.\n   Every number, caveat, honesty note, limitation, tier label and refusal message\n   shown here is printed exactly as the local API returned it. The client never\n   sums, averages, rounds, rescales or draws chart geometry. */\nconst $ = (s, r) => (r || document).querySelector(s);\nconst $$ = (s, r) => Array.from((r || document).querySelectorAll(s));\nconst esc = (v) => String(v === null || v === undefined ? "" : v)\n  .replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;");\nconst txt = (v) => (v === null || v === undefined || v === "") ? "not recorded" : String(v);\n\n/* Subject and tool icons. Presentation only: the server supplies the icon key,\n   the client owns the drawing. No icon carries a number or a claim. */\nconst ICONS = {\n  accounting: \'<path d="M5 3h11a3 3 0 0 1 3 3v15H8a3 3 0 0 1-3-3z"/><path d="M8 7h7M8 11h7M8 15h4"/>\',\n  finance: \'<path d="M3 17l6-6 4 4 7-8"/><path d="M14 7h6v6"/>\',\n  economics: \'<path d="M12 3v18M5 7h14"/><path d="M5 7l-2 6a3 3 0 0 0 6 0z"/><path d="M19 7l-2 6a3 3 0 0 0 6 0z"/><path d="M8 21h8"/>\',\n  management: \'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 3v3M12 18v3M3 12h3M18 12h3"/>\',\n  project: \'<path d="M4 3v18"/><path d="M7 6h10M11 11h9M8 16h8"/>\',\n  entrepreneurship: \'<path } catch (e) {}\n}\n\nfunction route() {\n  let raw = (location.hash || "#/home").replace(/^#\\/?/, "");\n  let parts = raw.split("/").filter(Boolean);\n  let head = parts[0] || "home";\n  if (SESSION_ROUTES.includes(head) && !state.session && !state.delivery) {\n    const fallback = lastDurableRoute();\n    if (location.hash !== fallback) history.replaceState(null, "", fallback);\n    raw = fallback.replace(/^#\\/?/, "");\n    parts = raw.split("/").filter(Boolean);\n    head = parts[0] || "home";\n  } else {\n    rememberRoute(location.hash || "#/home");\n  }\n  if (head === "subject" && parts[1]) {\n    state.subjectId = decodeURIComponent(parts[1]);\n    state.subject = null;\n    show("subject");\n    return;\n  }\n  if (head === "case" && parts[1]) {\n    state.caseId = decodeURIComponent(parts[1]);\n    show("case");\n    return;\n  }\n  if (head === "portfolio" && parts[1]) {\n    state.portfolioId = decodeURIComponent(parts[1]);\n    show("portfolio");\n    return;\n  }\n  if (head === "chat") {\n    /* The chat is on Home now; an old #/chat link lands there with the cursor\n       already in the composer. */\n    show("home");\n    const box = $("#objective");\n    if (box) box.focus();\n    return;\n  }\n  show(PANELS.includes(head) ? head : "home");\n}\n\n/* ---------- panels ---------- */\nconst RENDERERS = {};\n\nRENDERERS.portfolio = function () { loadPortfolioPage(); } catch (error) { state.marketStatus = null; }\n    }\n    if (!state.instruments) {\n      try { state.instruments = await api("/api/portfolios/instruments"); } catch (error) { state.instruments = null; "Fetches from the market-data service, then checks nothing for you: read each price before you keep it." : "Live price fetching is not available right now. It opens in a new page, so a student can keep the\n   walkthrough beside the app instead of losing the book they were working on. */\nfunction pfGuideLink(where) {\n  const hero = where === "hero";\n  return \'<a class="pfguidepill" href="/guides/portfolio-lab-student-guide.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener"\' +\n    \' title="Open the Student guide as a printable PDF in a new page">\' +\n    \'<span class="pfpdf">PDF</span><span>Student guide \\u2014 four worked cases, click by click</span>\' +\n    \'<span aria-hidden="true">\\u2197</span></a>\';\n}\n\n/* "2026-10-28T21:46:17.668521+00:00" is precise and unreadable in a table column. state.portfolioPerformance = await api("/api/portfolios/" + encodeURIComponent(state.portfolioId) + "/performance");\n    state.portfolioPerformanceError = null;\n    renderPortfolioWorkspace();\n  } entry ends."); return; }\n  message.innerHTML = loading("Saving the entry");\n  try {\n    await post("/api/portfolios/" + encodeURIComponent(state.portfolioId) + "/journal", {\n      date: date,\n      flow: ($("#pfjflow").value || "0").trim(),\n      benchmark: ($("#pfjbench").value || "").trim(),\n      note: ($("#pfjnote").value || "").trim(),\n    });\n    state.portfolioPerformance = null;\n    await loadPortfolioPage();\n    const fresh = $("#pfmsg");\n    if (fresh) fresh.innerHTML = banner("ok", "Entry saved", "<p>The journal carries this date. "honesty" : "ok",\n        failed.length ? "Some prices were not fetched" : "Prices fetched",\n        "<p>" + esc(String(Object.keys(result.prices || {}).length)) + " stored for " + esc(date) + ".</p>" +\n        (failed.length ? \'<ul>\' + failed.map((row) => "<li>" + esc(row.symbol) + ": " + esc(row.error) + "</li>").join("") + "</ul>" : ""));\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    const text = String(error.message || error);\n    const limited = /limit|quota|premium|too many/i.test(text);\n    message.innerHTML = limited\n      ? banner("honesty", "The live quote service is busy",\n          "<p>It has reached its request limit for now.</p><p>Enter the prices yourself (or paste them); the snapshot stays blocked until every holding has one. Nothing is estimated.</p>")\n      : errorBanner(new Error(pfPlainError(error)));\n  }\n}\n\nasync function importHoldings() {\n  const message = $("#pfmsg");\n  const text = ($("#pfhimport").value || "");\n  if (!text.trim()) { message.innerHTML = banner("blocked", "Nothing to import", "Paste one row per holding first."); return; }\n  message.innerHTML = loading("Importing the holdings");\n  try {\n    const result = await post("/api/portfolios/" + encodeURIComponent(state.portfolioId) + "/holdings/import", { text: text });\n    state.portfolioTab = "holdings";\n    await loadPortfolioPage();\n    const fresh = $("#pfmsg");\n    if (fresh) fresh.innerHTML = banner("ok", "Holdings imported", "<p>" + esc(String((result.holdings || []).length)) + " holdings are now stored. Add a price for each before the snapshot.</p>");\n  } catch (error) { message.innerHTML = errorBanner(error); }\n}\n\nasync function importPrices() {\n  const message = $("#pfmsg");\n  const text = ($("#pfpimport").value || "");\n  const date = ($("#pfdate").value || "").trim();\n  if (!date) { message.innerHTML = banner("blocked", "A date is needed", "Choose the price date above."); return; }\n  if (!text.trim()) { message.innerHTML = banner("blocked", "Nothing to import", "Paste one row per holding first."); return; }\n  message.innerHTML = loading("Importing the prices");\n  try {\n    const result = await post("/api/portfolios/" + encodeURIComponent(state.portfolioId) + "/prices/import", { date: date, text: text, source: "user" });\n    state.portfolioTab = "data";\n    await loadPortfolioPage();\n    const fresh = $("#pfmsg");\n    if (fresh) fresh.innerHTML = banner("ok", "Prices imported", "<p>" + esc(String(Object.keys((result && result.prices) || {}).length)) + " prices are stored for " + esc(date) + ".</p>");\n  } catch (error) { message.innerHTML = errorBanner(error); }\n}\n\nasync function removeHolding(symbol) {\n  try {\n    await api("/api/portfolios/" + encodeURIComponent(state.portfolioId) + "/holdings/" + encodeURIComponent(symbol), { method: "DELETE" });\n    toast("Holding " + symbol + " removed.");\n    await loadPortfolioPage();\n  } catch (error) { toast(error.message || String(error)); }\n}\n\nasync function createSnapshot() {\n  const message = $("#pfmsg");\n  const date = ($("#pfdate").value || "").trim();\n  const cash = ($("#pfcash").value || "0").trim();\n  const prices = {};\n  $$("[data-pfprice]").forEach((input) => { if (input.value.trim()) prices[input.dataset.pfprice] = { price: input.value.trim(), source: "user" }; });\n  if (!date) { message.innerHTML = banner("blocked", "A date is needed", "Choose the snapshot date."); return; }\n  message.innerHTML = loading("Valuing the portfolio");\n  try {\n    state.portfolioSnapshot = await post("/api/portfolios/" + encodeURIComponent(state.portfolioId) + "/snapshot",\n      { date: date, cash: cash, prices: prices });\n    state.portfolioTab = "data";\n    await loadPortfolioPage();\n    const fresh = $("#pfmsg");\n    if (fresh) fresh.innerHTML = banner("ok", "Snapshot created",\n      "<p>The valuation for " + esc(date) + " is stored. The\n           framework is inferred from the brief, so nothing here reaches the user. */\n        \'<select id="chatframework" hidden aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">\' +\n          \'<option value="">Infer from the brief</option>\' +\n          \'<option value="pestel">PESTEL</option>\' +\n          \'<option value="swot">SWOT</option>\' +\n          \'<option value="pestel_swot">PESTEL + SWOT</option>\' +\n          \'<option value="five_forces">Five Forces</option>\' +\n          \'<option value="five_forces_breakeven">Five Forces + Break-even</option>\' +\n        "</select>" +\n        \'<button type="button" id="chatstart" hidden tabindex="-1">Start the analysis</button>\' +\n        \'<button class="runbtn" id="run" type="button" aria-label="Start the analysis" title="Start the analysis (Enter)">\' +\n          \'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 19V5M6 11l6-6 6 6"/></svg>\' +\n        "</button>" +\n      "</div>" +\n      \'<div id="attachments" class="attachments" aria-live="polite"></div>\' +\n    "</div>" +\n    \'<div class="card" id="chatcard" hidden><div id="chatout" aria-live="polite"></div></div>\' +\n    \'<div class="card" id="homedocs" style="margin-top:16px"></div>\';\n  $("#run").onclick = startChat;\n  const legacy = $("#chatstart");\n  if (legacy) legacy.onclick = startChat;\n  $("#objective").addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {\n    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey && !e.isComposing) { e.preventDefault(); startChat(); }\n  });\n  bindAttachments(p);\n  loadAttachments();\n  renderChat();\n  loadHomeDocuments();\n};\n\n/* ---------- the student\'s papers, listed on Home ---------- */\nasync function loadHomeDocuments() {\n  const box = document.getElementById("homedocs");\n  if (!box) return;\n  box.innerHTML = \'<div class="sechead"><h3>Documents</h3></div>\' +\n    \'<p class="muted" style="margin-bottom:0">Loading...</p>\';\n  try {\n    const data = await api("/api/cases/documents");\n    state.homeDocs = (data && data.documents) || [];\n    renderHomeDocuments();\n  } catch (error) {\n    box.innerHTML = \'<div class="sechead"><h3>Documents</h3></div><p class="muted" style="margin-bottom:0">\' +\n      esc(error && error.message ? error.message : String(error)) + "</p>";\n  }\n}\n\n/* The samples are grouped, not listed: one worked example with three lengths,\n   and the other samples in one quiet section. An explainer is a link on its\n   paper\'s row, never a row of its own. */\nfunction renderHomeDocuments() {\n  const box = document.getElementById("homedocs");\n  if (!box) return;\n  const rows = state.homeDocs || [];\n  const mine = rows.filter((row) => !row.sample);\n  const samples = rows.filter((row) => row.sample);\n\n  const lengths = [\n    { key: "short", label: "Short", range: "600-1,200" },\n    { key: "mid", label: "Mid", range: "1,200-2,500" },\n    { key: "long", label: "Long", range: "2,500-5,000" },\n  ];\n  const example = {};\n  lengths.forEach((length) => {\n    const paper = samples.find((row) => new RegExp("-" + length.key + "\\\\.docx$", "i").test(row.filename));\n    const explainer = samples.find((row) =>\n      new RegExp("-" + length.key + "-explainer\\\\.docx$", "i").test(row.filename));\n    if (paper) example[length.key] = { paper: paper, explainer: explainer };\n  });\n  const used = new Set();\n  Object.keys(example).forEach((key) => {\n    used.add(example[key].paper.filename);\n    if (example[key].explainer) used.add(example[key].explainer.filename);\n  });\n  const others = samples.filter((row) => !used.has(row.filename));\n  const chosen = lengths.find((length) => length.key === state.homeLength && example[length.key]) ||\n    lengths.find((length) => example[length.key]);\n\n  const size = (row) => Math.max(1, Math.round((row.size || 0) / 1024)) + " KB";\n  const meta = (row) => [row.framework, row.version, size(row), fmtDate(row.created)]\n    .filter(Boolean).map(esc).join(" \\u00b7 ");\n  const paperLink = (row) => \'<a class="doclink" href="\' + esc(row.download) + \'" download="\' +\n    esc(row.filename) + \'">Open the paper</a>\';\n  const explainerLink = (row) => row ? \'<a class="doclink quiet" href="\' + esc(row.download) +\n    \'" download="\' + esc(row.filename) + \'">How it was solved</a>\' : "";\n\n  let html = \'<div class="sechead"><h3>Documents</h3>\' +\n    \'<span class="muted">Word files, ready to open</span></div><div class="docs">\';\n\n  if (mine.length) {\n    html += \'<section><div class="sechead"><h4 class="levelhead" style="margin:0">Your papers</h4></div>\' +\n      mine.map((row) => \'<div class="docrow"><div class="docmain"><strong>\' + esc(row.title) + \'</strong>\' +\n        \'<div class="docmeta">\' + meta(row) + (row.words ? " \\u00b7 " + esc(String(row.words)) + " words" : "") +\n        \'</div></div><div class="doclinks">\' + paperLink(row) + \'</div></div>\').join("") + \'</section>\';\n  }\n\n  if (Object.keys(example).length) {\n    const current = example[chosen.key];\n    const baseTitle = String(current.paper.title || "").replace(/\\s+-\\s+(Short|Mid|Long)\\s*\\([^)]*\\)\\s*$/i, "");\n    html += \'<section class="worked"><div class="exhead"><span class="extitle">Worked example</span>\' +\n      \'<span class="muted">One framework, one computation, three lengths</span></div>\' +\n      \'<div class="row" style="justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap">\' +\n      \'<div class="docmain"><strong>\' + esc(baseTitle) + \'</strong>\' +\n      \'<div class="docmeta">\' + esc(current.paper.framework || "") + " \\u00b7 " +\n      esc(chosen.label) + " (" + esc(chosen.range) + " words) \\u00b7 " + size(current.paper) + \'</div></div>\' +\n      \'<div class="doclinks">\' + paperLink(current.paper) + explainerLink(current.explainer) + \'</div></div>\' +\n      \'<div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Worked example length" style="margin-top:12px">\' +\n      lengths.filter((length) => example[length.key]).map((length) =>\n        \'<button type="button" data-sample-length="\' + esc(length.key) + \'" aria-pressed="\' +\n        (length.key === chosen.key ? "true" : "false") + \'">\' + esc(length.label) +\n        \' <span class="muted">\' + esc(length.range) + "</span></button>").join("") +\n      "</div></section>";\n  }\n\n  if (others.length) {\n    html += \'<section><div class="sechead"><h4 class="levelhead" style="margin:0">More samples</h4></div>\' +\n      others.map((row) => \'<div class="docrow"><div class="docmain"><strong>\' + esc(row.title) + \'</strong>\' +\n        \'<div class="docmeta">\' + meta(row) + \'</div></div><div class="doclinks">\' + paperLink(row) +\n        \'</div></div>\').join("") + "</section>";\n  }\n\n  if (!mine.length && !Object.keys(example).length && !others.length) {\n    html += \'<div class="emptydocs">No papers yet. Describe a case above and the paper appears here.</div>\';\n  }\n  box.innerHTML = html + "</div>";\n\n  box.querySelectorAll("[data-sample-length]").forEach((button) => {\n    button.onclick = () => {\n      state.homeLength = button.dataset.sampleLength;\n      renderHomeDocuments();\n    };\n  });\n}\n\n/* ---------- the deterministic conductor, rendered on the Home page ---------- */\n/* There is no Chat panel any more: the composer is the Home box (`#objective`)\n   and every stage of the conversation renders into `#chatout` below it. */\nfunction renderChat() {\n  const out = $("#chatout"); if (!out) return;\n  const card = $("#chatcard");\n  if (card) card.hidden = !state.chat;\n  const c = state.chat;\n  if (!c) {\n    /* The Home page is the composer and nothing else until there is a brief to\n       answer. No explainer, no framework picker: the box, Attach files, the arrow. */\n    out.innerHTML = "";\n    return;\n  }\n  let html = \'<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:12px"><div class="row" style="justify-content:space-between">\' +\n    \'<strong>Your brief</strong><button class="btn sm" id="chatreset">Start over</button></div>\' +\n    \'<p style="margin:6px 0 0">\' + esc(c.brief) + "</p></div>";\n  if (c.stage === "not_supported") {\n    const detected = c.subject_detected;\n    const shelfBtn = detected\n      ? \'<div class="row" style="margin-top:8px"><button class="btn" id="chatshelf">Open the \' + esc(detected.label) + \' shelf</button></div>\'\n      : \'<div class="row" style="margin-top:8px"><button class="btn" id="chatshelves">Browse the subjects</button></div>\';\n    html += \'<div class="card">\' + banner("blocked", "This analysis is not the right tool here", "<p>" + esc(c.message) + "</p>") +\n      shelfBtn + \'</div>\';\n    out.innerHTML = html;\n    if (detected) {\n      $("#chatshelf").onclick = () => openSubject(detected.id);\n    } else {\n      $("#chatshelves").onclick = () => show("subjects");\n    }\n    $("#chatreset").onclick = resetChat;\n    return;\n  }\n  if (c.stage === "clarify") {\n    const q = c.questions[c.question_index];\n    html += \'<div class="card"><h3>Before I plan</h3>\';\n    c.questions.slice(0, c.question_index).forEach((answered) => {\n      const value = c.answers[answered.id];\n      const shown = Array.isArray(value) ? value.join("; ") : (value || "skipped");\n      html += \'<p class="muted" style="margin:8px 0 0">\' + esc(answered.prompt) + "</p>" +\n        \'<p style="margin:2px 0 10px"><strong>\' + esc(shown) + "</strong></p>";\n    });\n    html += \'<p class="sub" style="margin-bottom:4px"><strong>\' + esc(q.prompt) + "</strong></p>" +\n      \'<p class="muted">\' + esc(q.why) + "</p>";\n    if (q.type === "choice") {\n      html += \'<div class="row" style="flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px">\' + q.choices.map((choice) => {\n        const value = Array.isArray(choice) ? choice[0] : choice;\n        const label = Array.isArray(choice) ? choice[1] : choice;\n        return \'<button class="btn sm" data-chatanswer="\' + esc(value) + \'">\' + esc(label) + "</button>";\n      }).join("") + "</div>";\n    } else {\n      const placeholder = q.type === "items" ? "One item; another item" : "";\n      html += \'<div class="row" style="margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">\' +\n        \'<input id="chatanswer" type="text" style="flex:1;min-width:260px" placeholder="\' + esc(placeholder) + \'" value="\' + esc(Array.isArray(c.answers[q.id]) ? c.answers[q.id].join("; ") : (c.answers[q.id] || "")) + \'">\' +\n        \'<button class="btn primary" id="chatsend">Send</button>\' +\n        (q.allow_skip ? \'<button class="btn" id="chatskip">Skip</button>\' : "") + "</div>" +\n        (q.type === "items"\n          ? \'<div class="row" style="margin-top:6px"><button class="btn sm" id="chatassist" type="button">\' +\n            "Not sure? Propose a line from my own words</button></div>" +\n            \'<div class="row" id="chatassistlist" style="margin-top:6px;flex-wrap:wrap"></div>\'\n          : "");\n    }\n    html += "</div>";\n    out.innerHTML = html;\n    $("#chatreset").onclick = resetChat;\n    $$("[data-chatanswer]", out).forEach((button) => {\n      button.onclick = () => answerChat(q.id, button.dataset.chatanswer);\n    });\n    const send = $("#chatsend");\n    if (send) send.onclick = () => answerChat(q.id, $("#chatanswer").value);\n    const input = $("#chatanswer");\n    if (input) input.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {\n      if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) { event.preventDefault(); answerChat(q.id, input.value); }\n    });\n    const skip = $("#chatskip");\n    if (skip) skip.onclick = () => answerChat(q.id, "");\n    const help = $("#chatassist");\n    if (help) help.onclick = () => askAssist(q.id, q.prompt);\n    return;\n  }\n  if (c.stage === "plan" || c.stage === "research_ready") {\n    const plan = c.plan;\n    html += \'<div class="card"><h3>Proposed plan</h3>\' +\n      \'<p><strong>\' + esc(plan.framework) + ".</strong> " + esc(plan.why) + "</p>" +\n      (c.subject_detected ? \'<p class="muted">Read as: \' + esc(c.subject_detected.label) + \' (detected from your brief)</p>\' : "") +\n      \'<p><strong>What it misses.</strong> \' + esc(plan.misses) + "</p>" +\n      \'<p class="muted">Decision: \' + esc(plan.decision) + " · Region: " + esc(plan.geography) +\n        " · Period: " + esc(plan.period) + " · Citation style: " + esc(plan.style) + "</p>" +\n      \'<div class="tablewrap"><table><caption>The source dimensions and their plan</caption><thead><tr>\' +\n      "<th>Dimension</th><th>Query</th><th>Preferred sources</th></tr></thead><tbody>" +\n      plan.dimensions.map((dimension) => "<tr><td>" + esc(dimension.label) + "</td><td>" +\n        esc(dimension.query) + "</td><td>" + esc(dimension.source_note) + "</td></tr>").join("") +\n      "</tbody></table></div>" +\n      (plan.internal ? The projected statements \' +\n      "refuse an opening balance sheet that does not balance, and the export stays blocked until every required block runs.</p>";\n    (plan.blocks || []).forEach((block) => {\n      const stored = ((d.computations || {})[block.key] || {}).inputs || (p.blocks || {})[block.key] || {};\n      html += planBlockInputs(block, stored);\n      html += planResultTable(block, (d.computations || {})[block.key]);\n    });\n    html += \'<div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn primary" id="plancompute">Run the declared computations</button></div></div>\';\n\n    // -- evidence\n    html += \'<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:12px"><h3 style="margin-top:0">Market evidence</h3>\' +\n      \'<p class="sub">Retrieval fills the market dimensions from academic and vetted sources.
