" (" + esc(source.year) + ")" : "") + "</span></label>";\n      }).join("") + "</div>";\n    }\n    if (d.gaps && d.gaps.length) {\n      html += \'<p class="muted">Named gaps: \' + d.gaps.map((gap) => esc(gap.label)).join(", ") + ".</p>";\n    }\n    (d.notes || []).slice(0, 5).forEach((note) => { html += \'<p class="muted">\' + esc(note) + "</p>"; });\n    html += \'<div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn" id="planresearch">Find market evidence</button>\' +\n      \'<button class="btn primary" id="plandraft">Draft the plan</button></div></div>\';\n  }\n\n  if (d.draft) {\n    html += \'<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:12px"><h3 style="margin-top:0">Draft</h3>\' +\n      "<p><strong>" + esc(d.draft.title) + "</strong></p>";\n    if ((d.draft.missing || []).length) {\n      html += banner("blocked", "Complete the plan before export",\n        "<p>Still needed: " + d.draft.missing.map(esc).join(", ") + ". The download is blocked until these are supplied.</p>");\n      // A criterion the marking guide weights and no section of this profile can carry is\n      // the student\'s decision, not a silent block: they may accept the gap, which is\n      // recorded, and the coverage table keeps naming it.\n      if ((d.draft.missing || []).some((item) => /criterion your rubric states/.test(String(item)))) {\n        html += \'<div class="row" style="margin-bottom:8px"><button class="btn sm" id="planrubricgate">\' +\n          "Accept the rubric gap and download</button><span class=\\"muted\\">Your marking guide is kept: " +\n          "the coverage table still names every gap, and the decision is recorded on this plan.</span></div>";\n      }\n    } else {\n      html += \'<div class="row" style="margin-bottom:8px"><button class="btn primary" id="plandownload">Download the plan</button>\' +\n        \'<span class="muted">A plan with a computation downloads as a ZIP with its explainer.</span></div>\';\n    }\n    html += \'<details class="studynote"><summary><strong>Read the drafted plan</strong></summary>\' +\n      planOutlineHtml(d.draft.outline) + "</details></div>";\n  }\n  out.innerHTML = html;\n  const reset = $("#planreset"); if (reset) reset.onclick = () => { state.plan = null; renderPlan(); };\n  const confirm = $("#planconfirm"); if (confirm) confirm.onclick = () => planPost("plan", {});\n  const customise = $("#plancustomise");\n  if (customise) customise.onclick = () => {\n    const body = { level: $("#plancustomlevel").value, mode: $("#plancustommode").value };\n    const drop = $$("[data-plandrop]:checked").map((box) => box.value);\n    if (drop.length) body.sections = drop;\n    planPost("customise", body);\n  };\n  const save = $("#plansaveinputs");\n  if (save) save.onclick = () => {\n    capturePlanForms();\n    planPost("inputs", { values: state.plan.student || {} });\n  };\n  const compute = $("#plancompute");\n  if (compute) compute.onclick = () => {\n    capturePlanForms();\n    planPost("compute", { blocks: state.plan.blocks || {} });\n  };\n  const research = $("#planresearch"); if (research) research.onclick = () => planPost("research", {});\n  const draft = $("#plandraft");\n  if (draft) draft.onclick = () => {\n    const accepted = $$("[data-planevidence]:checked").map((box) => box.value);\n    planPost("draft", { accepted: accepted });\n  };\n  const download = $("#plandownload"); if (download) download.onclick = downloadPlan;\n  const rubricGate = $("#planrubricgate");\n  if (rubricGate) rubricGate.onclick = () => planPost("rubric-gate", { enabled: false });\n}\n\nasync function planPost(action, body) {\n  if (!state.plan || !state.plan.data) return;\n  capturePlanForms();\n  const out = $("#planout");\n  out.innerHTML = loading("Working");\n  try {\n    state.plan.data = await post("/api/cases/chat/" + encodeURIComponent(state.plan.data.id) + "/" + action, body || {});\n    state.plan.error = null;\n    renderPlan();\n  } catch (error) {\n    state.plan.error = error.message;\n    renderPlan();\n  }\n}\n\n/* What the student will be held to, when they read a marking guide from a file.\n   The plan runs the same coverage check the completed worksheets run: the paper gets a\n   coverage table, and a weighted criterion it does not address blocks the download.\n   Nothing here marks the paper. */\nfunction rubricNoteHtml() {\n  const parsed = state.rubric;\n  const criteria = (parsed && parsed.criteria) || [];\n  if (!criteria.length) return "";\n  return \'<p class="muted" style="margin:8px 0 0">The marking guide you read (\' + criteria.length +\n    (criteria.length === 1 ? " criterion" : " criteria") + ") travels with this plan: the paper " +\n    "carries a coverage table, and the download is blocked while a weighted criterion it names is " +\n    "unaddressed. It does not mark the paper.</p>";\n}\n\nasync function beginPlan() {\n  const out = $("#planout");\n  let brief = (($("#planbrief") || {}).value || "").trim();\n  const level = $("#planlevel").value, mode = $("#planmode").value;\n  const input = $("#planfile");\n  let attachment = null;\n  out.innerHTML = loading("Proposing the plan");\n  try {\n    if (input && input.files && input.files[0]) {\n      const file = input.files[0];\n      const encoded = await readAsBase64(file);\n      attachment = await post("/api/cases/brief", { filename: file.name, data: encoded });\n      if (attachment.status !== "extracted") throw new Error(attachment.reason || "the brief could not be read");\n      brief = (brief ? brief + "\\n" : "") + attachment.text;\n    }\n    if (brief.trim().length < 15) {\n      throw new Error("Describe the business in at least one sentence, or attach a brief.");\n    }\n    state.planMode = mode;\n    const body = { brief: brief, profile: "business_plan", subject: "entrepreneurship",\n      level: level, mode: mode };\n    // The marking guide read on the intake card travels with the run: the paper carries a\n    // coverage table and the download is blocked while a weighted criterion is unaddressed.\n    if (state.rubric) body.rubric = state.rubric;\n    const data = await post("/api/cases/chat", body);\n    state.plan = { data: data, attachment: attachment, error: null, student: null, blocks: null };\n    renderPlan();\n  } catch (error) {\n    state.plan = state.plan || {};\n    state.plan.data = null;\n    state.plan.error = error.message;\n    renderPlan();\n    toast(error.message);\n  }\n}\n\nasync function downloadPlan() {\n  const out = $("#planout");\n  out.insertAdjacentHTML("afterbegin", loading("Preparing the plan"));\n  try {\n    const result = await post("/api/cases/chat/" + encodeURIComponent(state.plan.data.id) + "/export", {});\n    const binary = atob(result.data), bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);\n    for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);\n    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes], { type: result.mime }));\n    const link = document.createElement("a");\n    link.href = url; link.download = result.filename;\n    document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); link.remove();\n    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 4000);\n    toast(result.contents ? "Plan and explainer downloaded: " + result.filename\n                          : "Plan downloaded: " + result.filename);\n  } catch (error) { state.plan.error = error.message; renderPlan(); }\n}\n\n/* ---------- intake: attached files ---------- */\nfunction fileSize(bytes) {\n  const n = Number(bytes);\n  if (!isFinite(n) || n < 0) return "size not recorded";\n  if (n < 1024) return n + " B";\n  if (n < 1024 * 1024) return (n / 1024).toFixed(1) + " KB";\n  return (n / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + " MB";\n}\n\nfunction readAsBase64(file) {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    const reader = new FileReader();\n    reader.onload = () => {\n      const text = String(reader.result || "");\n      const comma = text.indexOf(",");\n      resolve(comma >= 0 ? text.slice(comma + 1) : "");\n    };\n    reader.onerror = () => reject(reader.error || new Error("the file could not be read"));\n    reader.readAsDataURL(file);\n  });\n}\n\nasync function uploadAttachments(files) {\n  const list = Array.from(files || []);\n  if (!list.length) return;\n  const box = $("#attachments");\n  if (box) box.innerHTML = loading("Storing " + list.length + " file" + (list.length === 1 ? "" : "s"));\n  let stored = 0;\n  for (const file of list) {\n    try {\n      const content_base64 = await readAsBase64(file);\n      await post("/api/intake", { filename: file.name, content_base64: content_base64 });\n      stored += 1;\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast(file.name + ": " + (error.message || String(error)));\n    }\n  }\n  if (stored) toast(stored === 1 ? "File attached." : stored + " files attached.");\n  loadAttachments();\n}\n\nfunction intakeStatus(row) {\n  if (row.corrupt) return \'<span class="badge warn">record unreadable</span>\';\n  if (row.status === "ingested") return \'<span class="badge">Ingested</span>\';\n  if (row.status === "extracted") return \'<span class="badge">Text extracted (unverified)</span>\';\n  if (row.status === "ocr_required") return \'<span class="badge warn">OCR required</span>\';\n  if (row.status === "reference_only") return \'<span class="badge mute">Reference only</span>\';\n  if (row.error) return \'<span class="badge warn">Stored, not read</span>\';\n  return \'<span class="badge mute">Stored</span>\';\n}\n\nfunction intakeDetail(row) {\n  if (row.corrupt) return \'<div class="muted">\' + esc(row.error) + "</div>";\n  if (row.error) return \'<div class="muted">\' + esc(row.error) + "</div>";\n  if (row.status === "ingested") {\n    const cols = (row.columns || []).join(", ");\n    return \'<div class="muted">\' + esc(row.n_rows) + " rows x " + esc(row.n_cols) + " columns" +\n      (cols ? \' <details><summary>Columns read</summary>\' + esc(cols) + "</details>" : "") + "</div>";\n  }\n  if (row.status === "extracted" && row.extraction) {\n    return \'<div class="muted">\' + esc(row.extraction.pages) + " page(s), " + esc(row.extraction.chars) +\n      " characters - " + esc(row.note) + "</div>";\n  }\n  return \'<div class="muted">\' + esc(row.note) + "</div>";\n}\n\nfunction isReadableDocument(row) {\n  return row.kind === "document" && [".pdf", ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg"].includes(String(row.ext || "").toLowerCase());\n}\n\n/* The extensions documents.extract_document can open.  A file with one of these can be\n   used as the paper\'s instruction; anything else is refused by the route with its own\n   reason, so the button is only offered where a reader exists. */\nfunction canBeBrief(row) {\n  return [".pdf", ".docx", ".docm", ".txt", ".text", ".md", ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp"]\n    .includes(String(row.ext || "").toLowerCase());\n}\n\nfunction intakeRow(row) {\n  const id = row.id || "";\n  const actions =\n    (row.kind === "structured" && row.status !== "ingested"\n      ? \'<button class="btn sm" type="button" data-ingest="\' + esc(id) + \'">Ingest</button>\' : "") +\n    (isReadableDocument(row) && row.status !== "extracted"\n      ? \'<button class="btn sm" type="button" data-extract="\' + esc(id) + \'">Extract text</button>\' : "") +\n    (canBeBrief(row)\n      ? \'<button class="btn sm" type="button" data-brief="\' + esc(id) + \'">Use as the instruction</button>\' : "") +\n    (canBeBrief(row)\n      ? \'<button class="btn sm" type="button" data-rubric="\' + esc(id) + \'">Use as the rubric</button>\' : "") +\n    (row.kind === "sources"\n      ? \'<button class="btn sm" type="button" data-showsources="\' + esc(id) + \'">Show sources</button>\' : "") +\n    (row.status === "extracted"\n      ? \'<button class="btn sm" type="button" data-showtext="\' + esc(id) + \'">Show text</button>\' : "") +\n    \'<button class="btn sm" type="button" data-remove="\' + esc(id) + \'">Remove</button>\';\n  return \'<div class="attachrow"><div class="attachmeta"><strong>\' + esc(row.filename || id) + "</strong>" +\n    \'<div class="muted">\' + esc(fileSize(row.bytes)) + " - " + intakeStatus(row) +\n    (row.role === "brief" ? " - used as the instruction" : "") +\n    (row.role === "rubric" ? " - used as the marking guide" : "") +\n    (typeof row.n_sources === "number" ? " - " + esc(row.n_sources) + " declared source(s)" : "") +\n    "</div>" +\n    intakeDetail(row) + \'<div data-textbox="\' + esc(id) + \'"></div></div><div class="row">\' + actions + "</div></div>";\n}\n\nasync function loadAttachments() {\n  const box = $("#attachments");\n  if (!box) return;\n  try {\n    const data = await api("/api/intake");\n    const rows = (data && data.files) || [];\n    if (!rows.length) {\n      box.innerHTML = \'<p class="muted">No files attached. Spreadsheets are read into a typed table; a PDF, Word \' +\n        "or text file can be used as the instruction; images can be read on request; every other file is " +\n        "stored and labelled not read.</p>";\n      return;\n    }\n    box.innerHTML = rows.map(intakeRow).join("");\n    // Which of the student\'s own source lists a paper may cite (B-182): only ones that were read.\n    state.intakeSources = rows.filter(function (row) {\n      return row.kind === "sources" && typeof row.n_sources === "number";\n    }).map(function (row) { return row.id; });\n    $$("[data-ingest]", box).forEach((b) => { b.onclick = () => ingestAttachment(b.dataset.ingest); });\n    $$("[data-extract]", box).forEach((b) => { b.onclick = () => extractAttachment(b.dataset.extract); });\n    $$("[data-showtext]", box).forEach((b) => { b.onclick = () => showAttachmentText(b.dataset.showtext); });\n    $$("[data-brief]", box).forEach((b) => { b.onclick = () => useAsBrief(b.dataset.brief); });\n    $$("[data-rubric]", box).forEach((b) => { b.onclick = () => useAsRubric(b.dataset.rubric); });\n    $$("[data-showsources]", box).forEach((b) => { b.onclick = () => showDeclaredSources(b.dataset.showsources); });\n    $$("[data-remove]", box).forEach((b) => { b.onclick = () => removeAttachment(b.dataset.remove); });\n  } catch (error) {\n    box.innerHTML = errorBanner(error);\n  }\n}\n\nasync function extractAttachment(id) {\n  try {\n    const record = await post("/api/intake/" + encodeURIComponent(id) + "/extract", {});\n    toast(record.status === "extracted" ? "Text extracted; it is unverified." :\n      record.status === "ocr_required" ? "OCR is required for this file." : "The file could not be read.");\n  } catch (error) {\n    toast(error.message || String(error));\n  }\n  loadAttachments();\n}\n\nasync function showAttachmentText(id) {\n  const box = document.querySelector(\'[data-textbox="\' + id + \'"]\');\n  if (!box) return;\n  box.innerHTML = loading("Reading the extracted text");\n  try {\n    const data = await api("/api/intake/" + encodeURIComponent(id) + "/text?limit=6000");\n    box.innerHTML = \'<div class="muted">Unverified text; check it against the document. \' +\n      (data.truncated ? "Showing the first part of " + esc(data.chars) + " characters." : esc(data.chars) + " characters.") +\n      \'</div><pre class="doctext">\' + esc(data.text) + "</pre>";\n  } catch (error) {\n    box.innerHTML = errorBanner(error);\n  }\n}\n\n/* Show a student\'s own source list (B-182).  These are their citations: the panel says,\n   in the same breath, that they are not evidence and that nothing was verified. */\nasync function showDeclaredSources(id) {\n  const box = document.querySelector(\'[data-textbox="\' + id + \'"]\');\n  if (!box) return;\n  box.innerHTML = loading("Reading your source list");\n  try {\n    const data = await api("/api/intake/" + encodeURIComponent(id) + "/sources");\n    const lines = (data.citations || []).map((line) => "<li>" + esc(line) + "</li>").join("");\n    const problems = (((data.sources || {}).problems) || []).map((item) =>\n      "<li>" + esc(item.problem) + (item.line ? " (line " + esc(item.line) + ")" : "") + "</li>").join("");\n    box.innerHTML = \'<div class="muted">These are your own citations. They are not evidence and this \' +\n      "system has not verified them, so a part of the paper that has no retrieved evidence still " +\n      \'names that as a gap.</div>\' +\n      (lines ? "<ul>" + lines + "</ul>" : \'<div class="muted">No entry could be read.</div>\') +\n      (problems ? \'<div class="muted">Entries that could not be read:</div><ul>\' + problems + "</ul>" : "");\n  } catch (error) {\n    box.innerHTML = errorBanner(error);\n  }\n}\n\n/* Read a stored file as the paper\'s instruction.  The route extracts the text with the\n   same reader the brief route uses; nothing is started here.  The text lands in the brief\n   box for the student to read and correct, because extracted text is unverified. */\nasync function useAsBrief(id) {\n  try {\n    const data = await post("/api/intake/" + encodeURIComponent(id) + "/brief", {});\n    const box = $("#objective");\n    if (box) {\n      box.value = data.text || "";\n      box.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));\n      box.focus();\n      if (box.scrollIntoView) box.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });\n    }\n    toast("Read as the instruction: " + (data.chars || 0) +\n      " characters. It is unverified - check it before starting the analysis.");\n  } catch (error) {\n    toast(error.message || String(error));\n  }\n  loadAttachments();\n}\n\n/* Read a stored file as the paper\'s marking guide.  The route extracts and parses it;\n   nothing is started here.  The parsed rubric is held in page state and sent with the\n   run, where the paper measures coverage against it and the download is blocked while a\n   weighted criterion is unaddressed.  The student is told what was read, because\n   extracted text is unverified. */\nasync function useAsRubric(id) {\n  try {\n    const data = await post("/api/intake/" + encodeURIComponent(id) + "/rubric", {});\n    const parsed = data.rubric || {};\n    state.rubric = parsed;\n    const names = (parsed.criteria || []).map((row) => row.name).filter(Boolean);\n    let message = "Read as the marking guide: " + names.length + " " +\n      (names.length === 1 ? "criterion" : "criteria") +\n      (names.length ? " - " + names.join("; ") : "") + ".";\n    const problems = data.problems || [];\n    if (problems.length) message += " " + problems[0];\n    if (data.confirm_required) message += " Check it before the paper follows it.";\n    toast(message);\n  } catch (error) {\n    state.rubric = null;\n    toast(error.message || String(error));\n  }\n  loadAttachments();\n}\n\nasync function ingestAttachment(id) {\n  try {\n    await post("/api/intake/" + encodeURIComponent(id) + "/ingest", {});\n    toast("File read into a typed table.");\n  } catch (error) {\n    toast(error.message || String(error));\n  }\n  loadAttachments();\n}\n\nasync function removeAttachment(id) {\n  try {\n    await api("/api/intake/" + encodeURIComponent(id), { method: "DELETE" });\n  } catch (error) {\n    toast(error.message || String(error));\n  }\n  loadAttachments();\n}\n\nfunction bindAttachments(panel) {\n  const button = $("#attachbtn"), input = $("#attachfile"), box = panel && panel.querySelector(".actionbox");\n  if (button && input) {\n    button.onclick = () => input.click();\n    input.onchange = (event) => { uploadAttachments(event.target.files); event.target.value = ""; };\n  }\n  if (!box) return;\n  ["dragenter", "dragover"].forEach((name) => box.addEventListener(name, (event) => {\n    event.preventDefault(); box.classList.add("dragging");\n  }));\n  ["dragleave", "dragend"].forEach((name) => box.addEventListener(name, () => box.classList.remove("dragging")));\n  box.addEventListener("drop", (event) => {\n    event.preventDefault(); box.classList.remove("dragging");\n    if (event.dataTransfer && event.dataTransfer.files) uploadAttachments(event.dataTransfer.files);\n  });\n}\n\nfunction subjectCard(row) {\n  return \'<button class="subjectcard" type="button" data-subject="\' + esc(row.id) + \'">\' +\n    \'<span class="shield"><span class="capicon" style="color:\' + toneOf(row.id) + \'">\' + iconSvg(row.icon) + "</span>" +\n      \'<span class="sctitle">\' + esc(row.label) + "</span></span>" +\n    \'<span class="scdesc">\' + esc(row.summary) + "</span>" +\n    \'<span class="meta">\' +\n      \'<span class="badge">\' + esc(row.tool_count) + " calculations</span>" +\n      (row.worksheet_count ? \'<span class="badge mute">\' + esc(row.worksheet_count) + " worksheets</span>" : "") +\n      (row.record_count ? \'<span class="badge mute">\' + esc(row.record_count) + " records</span>" : "") +\n      (row.theory_count ? \'<span class="badge mute">\' + esc(row.theory_count) + " theory lenses</span>" : "") +\n      (row.cross_cutting ? \'<span class="badge warn">cross-cutting</span>\' : "") +\n    "</span>" +\n    \'<span class="capgo">Open the capabilities</span>\' +\n  "</button>";\n}\n\nfunction bindSubjectCards(root) {\n  $$("[data-subject]", root).forEach((b) => { b.onclick = () => openSubject(b.dataset.subject); });\n}\n\n/* One source of truth for the rail and the shelf: the product\'s subject index. */\nfunction ensureSubjects() {\n  if (state.subjects && state.subjects.length) return Promise.resolve(state.subjects);\n  return api("/api/cases/subjects").then((d) => {\n    state.subjects = (d && d.subjects) || [];\n    renderRailSubjects();\n    return state.subjects;\n  });\n}\n\nfunction renderRailSubjects() {\n  const box = $("#railsubjects"); if (!box) return;\n  const rows = state.subjects || [];\n  box.innerHTML = rows.map((row) =>\n    \'<a class="railitem" href="#/subject/\' + encodeURIComponent(row.id) + \'" data-panel="subject" data-subject="\' +\n      esc(row.id) + \'" style="--i:\' + railTone(row.id) + \'">\' +\n      \'<span class="ic">\' + railIconSvg(row.icon) + "</span>" +\n      \'<span class="railtext">\' + esc(row.label) + "</span>" +\n      \'<span class="railtip">\' + esc(row.label) + ": " + esc(row.tool_count) + " calculations" +\n        (row.worksheet_count ? ", " + esc(row.worksheet_count) + " worksheet" : "") +\n        (row.record_count ? ", " + esc(row.record_count) + " read-only records" : "") +\n        (row.theory_count ? ", " + esc(row.theory_count) + " theory lenses" : "") + "</span>" +\n    "</a>").join("");\n  // show() is not re-run here, so set the current marker for an already-open subject\n  markCurrentRailItem();\n}\n\nfunction loadRailSubjects() {\n  return api("/api/cases/subjects").then((d) => {\n    state.subjects = (d && d.subjects) || [];\n    renderRailSubjects();\n    return state.subjects;\n  }).catch((e) => {\n    // Keep the static subject list (rendered in the page) when the API is unavailable.\n    const box = $("#railsubjects");\n    if (box && !box.querySelector(".railfallback")) {\n      box.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", \'<span class="railfallback">Live counts unavailable: \' + esc(e.message) + "</span>");\n    }\n  });\n}\n\nasync function loadHomeShelf() {\n  const casesBox = $("#homecases"), subjectsBox = $("#homesubjects");\n  if (casesBox) {\n    api("/api/cases").then((d) => {\n      const rows = (d && d.cases) || [];\n      if (!rows.length) { casesBox.innerHTML = \'<div class="empty"><h3>No cases stored yet</h3><p>Start an analysis above and press "Save as case".</p></div>\'; return; }\n      casesBox.innerHTML = \'<div class="tablewrap"><table><caption>Stored cases, newest first</caption><thead><tr>\' +\n        "<th>Title</th><th>Method</th><th>Tier</th><th>Created</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>" +\n        rows.map((c) => "<tr" + (c.corrupt ? \' class="row-warn"\' : "") + "><td>" + esc(txt(c.title)) +\n          (c.corrupt ? \' <span class="badge warn">corrupt</span>\' : "") + "</td><td>" + esc(txt(c.method)) +\n          "</td><td>" + esc(txt(c.tier)) + "</td><td>" + esc(txt(c.created_at)) + "</td>" +\n          \'<td><button class="btn sm" data-open="\' + esc(c.id) + \'">Open</button></td></tr>\').join("") +\n        "</tbody></table></div>";\n      $$("[data-open]", casesBox).forEach((b) => { b.onclick = () => openCase(b.dataset.open); });\n    }).catch((e) => { casesBox.innerHTML = errorBanner(e); });\n  }\n  if (subjectsBox) {\n    ensureSubjects().then((rows) => {\n      subjectsBox.innerHTML = \'<div class="subjectgrid">\' + rows.map(subjectCard).join("") + "</div>";\n      bindSubjectCards(subjectsBox);\n    }).catch((e) => { subjectsBox.innerHTML = errorBanner(e); });\n  }\n}\n\n\nRENDERERS.subjects = function () {\n  const box = $("#subjectgallery");\n  box.innerHTML = loading("Reading the subject index");\n  ensureSubjects().then((rows) => {\n    if (!rows.length) {\n      box.innerHTML = banner("blocked", "No subjects returned", "<div>The server returned an empty subject index. Nothing has been invented here; check the local API.</div>");\n      return;\n    }\n    box.innerHTML = \'<div class="subjectgrid">\' + rows.map(subjectCard).join("") + "</div>";\n    bindSubjectCards(box);\n  }).catch((e) => { box.innerHTML = errorBanner(e); });\n};\n\nfunction openSubject(id) {\n  state.subjectId = id;\n  state.subject = null;\n  show("subject");\n}\n\nRENDERERS.subject = function () {\n  const out = $("#subjectout");\n  if (!state.subjectId) {\n    out.innerHTML = \'<div class="empty"><h3>No subject chosen</h3><p>Pick a subject from the rail, or open <a href="#/subjects">all subjects</a>.</p></div>\';\n    return;\n  }\n  out.innerHTML = loading("Reading the subject");\n  api("/api/cases/subjects/" + encodeURIComponent(state.subjectId)).then((d) => {\n    state.subject = d; renderSubject();\n  }).catch((e) => { out.innerHTML = errorBanner(e); });\n};\n\n\nfunction capabilityCard(item, kind) {\n  const isSheet = kind === "worksheet";\n  const attrs = isSheet\n    ? \'data-worksheet="\' + esc(item.template) + \'" data-wlabel="\' + esc(item.label) + \'"\'\n    : \'data-tool="\' + esc(item.key) + \'"\';\n  const domain = (state.subject && state.subject.label) || "This subject";\n  const need = (!isSheet && item.need)\n    ? \'<span class="capneed">You will need: \' + esc(item.need) + "</span>" : "";\n  const source = isSheet ? "Worksheet" : (item.preset ? "Worked example" : "Your figures");\n  /* Period moved to footer, below the source line */\n  const period = (!isSheet && item.period) ? \'<span class="lvl">\' + esc(item.period) + "</span>" : "";\n  return \'<button class="capcard" type="button" \' + attrs + ">" +\n    \'<span class="caphead"><span class="capicon" style="color:\' + toneOf(state.subjectId) + \'">\' + iconSvg(toolIcon(isSheet ? { kind: "worksheet" } : item)) + "</span>" +\n      "<strong>" + esc(item.label) + "</strong></span>" +\n    \'<span class="capdesc">\' + esc(item.what) + "</span>" + need +\n    \'<span class="capfoot">\' +\n      \'<span class="capfoot-row"><span>\' + esc(source) + \'</span>\' + (period ? \'<span class="capperiod">\' + period + "</span>" : "") + \'<span class="capgo">\' +\n      (isSheet ? "Open worksheet" : "Use this tool") + " &rarr;</span></span>" +\n      (need ? \'<span class="capfoot-row capneed-row">\' + need + "</span>" : "") +\n    \'</span>\' +\n  "</button>";\n}\n\nfunction frameworkCard(row, kind, domain, actionOverride) {\n  const theory = kind === "theory";\n  const method = kind === "method";\n  const action = actionOverride\n    || (theory ? "Read the lens" : (method ? "Read the method record" : "Read the framework"));\n  const description = theory\n    ? "Explains behaviour or relationships; use it to interpret evidence, not as a template."\n    : txt(row.structures);\n  return \'<button class="capcard" type="button" data-framework="\' + esc(row.id) + \'">\' +\n    \'<span class="caphead"><span class="capicon" style="color:\' + toneOf(state.subjectId) + \'">\' +\n      iconSvg("worksheet") + "</span><strong>" + esc(row.name) + "</strong></span>" +\n    \'<span class="capdesc">\' + esc(description) + "</span>" +\n    \'<span class="capfoot"><span>\' + esc(domain) + \'</span><span class="capgo">\' + esc(action) + " &rarr;</span></span>" +\n  "</button>";\n}\n\n/* A subject that declares its tiles shows them in the order a student meets\n   them.  Each tile says what it covers and what the student needs before\n   starting.  A tile with nothing in it is still shown and says why, because a\n   gap in a shelf is named rather than hidden; a catalogue-only framework is\n   shown as something to read and cite, never as a button that cannot work. */\nfunction subjectTiles(s) {\n  const tiles = s.tiles || [];\n  let html = \'<h3 style="margin-top:0">The tiles</h3>\' +\n    \'<p class="muted">Work down the tiles in the order the decision comes. A worksheet fills itself from your brief and the \' +\n    "evidence it can cite; a catalogue-only framework is something to read and cite until the owner builds one; a calculator " +\n    "runs a frozen method on the figures you declare.</p>";\n  const placed = new Set();\n  tiles.forEach((tile) => {\n    const sheets = tile.worksheets || [];\n    const rows = tile.records || [];\n    const tools = tile.tools || [];\n    rows.forEach((row) => placed.add(row.id));\n    html += \'<h4 class="levelhead">\' + esc(tile.label) + \' <button class="btn sm danger" data-close-tile="\' + esc(tile.key) + \'" type="button" title="Remove \' + esc(tile.label) + \' from this shelf" aria-label="Remove \' + esc(tile.label) + \' from this shelf">&times;</button></h4>\';\n    html += \'<p class="muted" style="margin:2px 0 6px">\' + esc(tile.what) + "</p>";\n    if (tile.need) {\n      html += \'<p class="muted" style="margin:0 0 8px"><strong>Before you start:</strong> \' + esc(tile.need) + "</p>";\n    }\n    if (!sheets.length && !rows.length && !tools.length) {\n      html += \'<p class="muted">\' + esc(tile.note || "Nothing is assigned to this tile yet.") + "</p>";\n      return;\n    }\n    if (tile.note) html += \'<p class="muted" style="margin:0 0 10px">\' + esc(tile.note) + "</p>";\n    if (sheets.length) {\n      html += \'<p class="muted" style="margin:0 0 6px">Worksheets: name the case and the framework fills itself.</p>\' +\n        \'<div class="capgrid">\' + sheets.map((w) => capabilityCard(w, "worksheet")).join("") + "</div>";\n    }\n    if (rows.length) {\n      /* A record backed by a computed method is surfaced as a calculator in the\n         tile and in the page-level "Method coverage and limits" panel, so it is\n         never shown here as a "no worksheet yet" card.  Only genuine gaps are\n         listed as read-and-cite cards. */\n      const readOnlyRows = rows.filter((row) => row.form !== "computed");\n      if (readOnlyRows.length) {\n        html += \'<p class="muted" style="margin:12px 0 6px">Catalogued frameworks with no worksheet yet: read and cite them, \' +\n          "and check what each one would need.</p>" +\n          \'<div class="capgrid">\' + readOnlyRows.map((row) => frameworkCard(row, "framework", tile.label,\n            "Read and cite - no worksheet yet")).join("") + "</div>";\n      }\n    }\n    if (tools.length) {\n      html += \'<p class="muted" style="margin:12px 0 6px">Calculators: supply the figures and confirm; the server computes \' +\n        "the result and its checks.</p>" +\n        \'<div class="capgrid">\' + tools.map((t) => capabilityCard(t, "compute")).join("") + "</div>";\n    }\n  });\n  /* Nothing is dropped: a record no tile claimed is still shown. */\n  const left = (s.records || []).filter((row) => !placed.has(row.id));\n  if (left.length) {\n    html += \'<h4 class="levelhead">Other catalogued frameworks - \' + left.length + "</h4>" +\n      \'<div class="capgrid">\' + left.map((row) => frameworkCard(row, "framework", row.discipline_label || "Other",\n        "Read and cite - no worksheet yet")).join("") + "</div>";\n  }\n  const theories = s.theories || [];\n  if (theories.length) {\n    html += \'<h4 class="levelhead">Reading lenses - \' + theories.length + "</h4>" +\n      \'<p class="muted">A theory explains behaviour or relationships; it does not prescribe a template. Read it to interpret \' +\n      "the evidence, retrieve the original research, cite it, and state its limits.</p>" +\n      \'<div class="capgrid">\' + theories.map((row) => frameworkCard(row, "theory", "Supporting theory")).join("") + "</div>";\n  }\n  return html;\n}\n\n/* A method id is shown as an acronym where it is one (irr -> IRR) and as words otherwise\n   (dcf_valuation -> DCF valuation). */\nconst METHOD_ACRONYMS = ["npv", "irr", "wacc", "capm", "dcf", "tvm", "ols", "eva", "roe", "roa",\n                         "eps", "eoq", "ccc", "var", "cvar", "ytm", "mirr", "pi", "roi", "fx",\n                         "abc", "cagr", "dso", "dio", "dpo", "spi", "cpi", "irf", "btc", "aic"];\n\nfunction methodName(id) {\n  const text = String(id || "").trim();\n  if (!text) return "";\n  return text.split("_").map((part, i) => METHOD_ACRONYMS.indexOf(part.toLowerCase()) !== -1\n    ? part.toUpperCase()\n    : (i === 0 ? part.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + part.slice(1) : part)).join(" ");\n}\n\n/* A schema field id shown as a title: present_value -> "Present Value", ebit -> "EBIT". */\nconst FIELD_ACRONYMS = ["ebit", "ebitda", "npv", "irr", "wacc", "capm", "dcf", "ytm", "eps", "roe",\n                        "roa", "roi", "pv", "fv", "dso", "dio", "dpo", "ccc", "eoq", "cagr",\n                        "var", "cvar", "spi", "cpi", "mirr", "fx", "tvm", "ols", "pi", "nwc"];\n\nfunction fieldTitle(name) {\n  return String(name || "").trim().split("_").filter(Boolean).map((part) =>\n    FIELD_ACRONYMS.indexOf(part.toLowerCase()) !== -1\n      ? part.toUpperCase()\n      : part.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + part.slice(1).toLowerCase()).join(" ");\n}\n\n/* The one way an input is labelled: the title, a dash, then the declared description.\n   The description is the frozen contract\'s own sentence; this never rewrites it. */\nfunction fieldLabel(name, desc, extra) {\n  const tail = [esc(desc || ""), esc(extra || "")].filter(Boolean).join(" ");\n  return \'<label class="field" for="in-\' + esc(name) + \'">\' + esc(fieldTitle(name)) +\n    (tail ? \' - <span class="muted">\' + tail + "</span>" : "") + "</label>";\n}\n\n/* Held back on the owner\'s request (2026-11-02).  The framework picker and the groups\n   listed here are not rendered, and their tiles are not built.  The markup is left in\n   place, so nothing else changes and surfacing them again is this object alone. */\nconst HOLD = { picker: true, groups: ["risk and decision analysis"] };\n\nfunction isHeldGroup(label) {\n  return HOLD.groups.indexOf(String(label || "").trim().toLowerCase()) !== -1;\n}\n\nfunction frameworkPicker(s, groups) {\n  if (HOLD.picker) return "";\n  const opts = [];\n  if (s.worksheets.length) {\n    opts.push(\'<optgroup label="Worksheets">\' + s.worksheets.map((w, i) =>\n      \'<option value="w:\' + i + \'">\' + esc(w.label) + "</option>").join("") + "</optgroup>");\n  }\n  groups.forEach((g) => {\n    opts.push(\'<optgroup label="\' + esc(g.label) + \'">\' + g.rows.map((r) =>\n      \'<option value="r:\' + esc(r.id) + \'">\' + esc(r.name) + "</option>").join("") + "</optgroup>");\n  });\n  if (s.theories.length) {\n    opts.push(\'<optgroup label="Reading lenses">\' + s.theories.map((r) =>\n      \'<option value="r:\' + esc(r.id) + \'">\' + esc(r.name) + "</option>").join("") + "</optgroup>");\n  }\n  const total = s.worksheets.length + groups.reduce((n, g) => n + g.rows.length, 0) + s.theories.length;\n  return \'<div class="row" style="gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 10px;flex-wrap:wrap">\' +\n    \'<label class="field" for="frameworkpick" style="margin:0">Choose a framework</label>\' +\n    \'<select id="frameworkpick" style="min-width:320px"><option value="">\' + esc(total) +\n    " frameworks - choose one</option>" + opts.join("") + "</select></div>";\n}\n\nfunction caseBriefBox() {\n  return \'<div class="card" style="margin:0 0 14px">\' +\n    \'<h3 style="margin-top:0">Describe your case or paste the instruction</h3>\' +\n    \'<p class="muted">We will suggest the framework that fits and open it with your description prefilled. \' +\n    "You then choose <strong>Complete this framework</strong>; the suggestion is not an analysis and no evidence is invented for you.</p>" +\n    \'<textarea id="casebrief" rows="3" style="width:100%" placeholder="For example: a local bakery faces a new competitor and we need to decide how to position it."></textarea>\' +\n    \'<div class="row" style="margin-top:8px;align-items:center"><button class="btn primary" id="casefind">Find the framework</button>\' +\n    \'<span class="muted" id="casefindnote"></span></div><div id="casefindout"></div></div>\';\n}\n\n/* Friendly label and launch target for a linked method id.  A subject tool is\n   preferred; otherwise fall back to any preset whose method matches (covers\n   methods that live on another shelf, e.g. npv / dcf). */\nfunction methodLabel(methodId) {\n  const tools = (state.subject && state.subject.tools) || [];\n  const tool = tools.find((t) => t.method === methodId);\n  if (tool) return tool.label;\n  const words = String(methodId || "").replace(/_/g, " ");\n  return words.replace(/\\b\\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());\n}\n\nfunction toolForMethod(methodId, subject) {\n  const tools = (subject && subject.tools) || [];\n  const direct = tools.find((t) => t.method === methodId);\n  if (direct) return direct;\n  const key = Object.keys(state.presets || {})\n    .find((k) => state.presets[k] && state.presets[k].method === methodId);\n  if (key) return { key: key, preset: key, method: methodId, label: methodLabel(methodId), what: "" };\n  return null;\n}\n\n/* The tail of a coverage note: what is deliberately not built yet, without the\n   leading "partial:" preamble. */\nfunction coverageLimit(note) {\n  const text = String(note || "");\n  const cut = text.lastIndexOf("; ");\n  let tail = cut >= 0 ? text.slice(cut + 2).trim() : text.replace(/^partial:\\s*/i, "").trim();\n  tail = tail.replace(/\\s+(is|are)\\s+not\\s+implemented\\.?\\s*$/i, "");\n  return tail || "None stated.";\n}\n\nfunction openFramework(row) {\n  const theory = row.form === "theory";\n  const body = \'<p class="muted">\' + esc(row.status_note) + "</p>" +\n    "<p><strong>What it covers.</strong> " + esc(txt(row.structures)) + "</p>" +\n    (row.evidence_needs ? "<p><strong>Evidence it needs.</strong> " + esc(row.evidence_needs) + "</p>" : "") +\n    "<p><strong>Discipline.</strong> " + esc((row.disciplines || []).join("; ")) + "</p>" +\n    \'<p class="muted">\' + (theory\n      ? "A theory explains behaviour or relationships; it is not a template. Read it to interpret the evidence, retrieve and cite the original research, and state its limits."\n      : "This is a catalogue record: you can read and cite it, but no worksheet or method runs for it yet.") + "</p>";\n  openModal(row.name, body, "Close", async () => {});\n}\n\nasync function findFramework() {\n  const text = ($("#casebrief").value || "").trim();\n  const out = $("#casefindout"), note = $("#casefindnote");\n  if (!text) { toast("Describe the case first."); return; }\n  note.textContent = "Matching the description...";\n  try {\n    const result = await post("/api/cases/match", { text: text });\n    const matches = (result && result.matches) || [];\n    note.textContent = "";\n    if (!matches.length) {\n      out.innerHTML = \'<p class="muted">\' + esc(result.none_reason || "No worksheet matches that description yet.") + "</p>";\n      return;\n    }\n    out.innerHTML = \'<p class="sub">Best fit: <strong>\' + esc(matches[0].label) +\n      "</strong>. Open it; your description becomes the instruction for completion.</p>" +\n      \'<div class="row" style="flex-wrap:wrap">\' + matches.map((m, i) =>\n        \'<button class="btn sm\' + (i === 0 ? " primary" : "") + \'" data-match="\' + esc(m.template) +\n        \'" data-mlabel="\' + esc(m.label) + \'">\' + esc(m.label) + "</button>").join("") + "</div>";\n    $$("[data-match]", out).forEach((button) => {\n      button.onclick = () => openWorksheet(button.dataset.match, button.dataset.mlabel, text);\n    });\n  } catch (e) {\n    note.textContent = "";\n    out.innerHTML = errorBanner(e);\n  }\n}\n\nfunction sourceFinderBox() {\n  const regions = ["Global", "US", "Europe", "Middle East", "China"];\n  const sheets = ((state.subject && state.subject.worksheets) || []).filter((worksheet) => worksheet.draftable);\n  return \'<div class="card" style="margin:0 0 14px">\' +\n    \'<h3 style="margin-top:0">Optional: search for sources</h3>\' +\n    \'<p class="muted">Use this only if you already know the sources you want. The case box above is the main path: describe your case, open the suggested worksheet, then complete it.</p>\' +\n    \'<div class="row" style="gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center">\' +\n      \'<input type="text" id="sourceq" placeholder="Optional: a source topic you already have, e.g. US grocery competition" style="flex:1;min-width:260px">\' +\n      \'<select id="sourceregion">\' + regions.map((r) => \'<option value="\' + r + \'">\' + r + \'</option>\').join("") + \'</select>\' +\n      \'<select id="sourcecategory"><option value="">All categories</option>\' +\n        ["legal", "economic", "social", "company", "news"].map((c) =>\n          \'<option value="\' + c + \'">\' + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1) + "</option>").join("") + \'</select>\' +\n      \'<label class="field" for="sourcerecent" style="margin:0"><input type="checkbox" id="sourcerecent" checked> Recent (last 10 years)</label>\' +\n      \'<button class="btn primary" id="sourcesearch">Search sources</button>\' +\n    \'</div>\' +\n    (sheets.length ? \'<div class="row" style="margin-top:10px;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap">\' +\n      \'<label class="field" for="drafttemplate" style="margin:0">Draft into</label>\' +\n      \'<select id="drafttemplate">\' + sheets.map((w, i) =>\n        \'<option value="\' + i + \'">\' + esc(w.label) + "</option>").join("") + "</select>" +\n      \'<button class="btn" id="draftbtn">Draft the worksheet from these sources</button>\' +\n      \'<span class="muted">The draft uses the sources above; review it before running.</span></div>\' : "") +\n    \'<div id="sourceout" style="margin-top:10px"></div><div id="draftout"></div>\' +\n    \'<details class="studynote" style="margin-top:12px"><summary>Browse vetted sources - legal, economic, social</summary>\' +\n      \'<p class="muted">Every site below is curated for academic use. Primary sources are legislation, courts, regulators, \' +\n      "statistics and official data; research sources are recognised research institutes; the news tier is background only.</p>" +\n      \'<div class="row" style="gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap">\' +\n        \'<label class="field" for="sitecategory" style="margin:0">Category</label>\' +\n        \'<select id="sitecategory"><option value="">All categories</option>\' +\n        ["legal", "economic", "social", "company", "news"].map((c) =>\n          \'<option value="\' + c + \'">\' + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1) + "</option>").join("") + "</select>" +\n        \'<button class="btn sm" id="sitesearch">Show vetted sources</button>\' +\n      \'</div><div id="sitedirectory"></div></details></div>\';\n}\n\nfunction siteCard(site) {\n  const tiers = { official: "Gov / intl org", data: "Data", research: "Research", news: "News" };\n  const fit = { primary: "Primary source", research: "Research", background: "Background only" };\n  return \'<a class="capcard" href="https://\' + esc(site.domain) + \'" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="text-decoration:none">\' +\n    \'<span class="caphead"><span class="capicon" style="color:\' + toneOf(state.subjectId) + \'">\' +\n      iconSvg("worksheet") + "</span><strong>" + esc(site.label) + "</strong></span>" +\n    \'<span class="capdesc">\' + esc(site.use) + "</span>" +\n    \'<span class="capfoot"><span>\' + esc(tiers[site.tier] || site.tier) + " · " +\n      esc(fit[site.academic_fit] || site.academic_fit) + \'</span><span class="capgo">Open site &rarr;</span></span></a>\';\n}\n\nasync function browseVettedSources() {\n  const region = ($("#sourceregion") || {}).value || "Global";\n  const category = ($("#sitecategory") || {}).value || "";\n  const out = $("#sitedirectory");\n  out.innerHTML = loading("Reading the vetted sources");\n  try {\n    let path = "/api/cases/sources/sites?region=" + encodeURIComponent(region);\n    if (category) path += "&category=" + encodeURIComponent(category);\n    const data = await api(path);\n    const groups = {};\n    (data.sites || []).forEach((site) => {\n      const key = site.category || "other";\n      (groups[key] = groups[key] || []).push(site);\n    });\n    let html = "";\n    Object.keys(groups).sort().forEach((key) => {\n      html += \'<h4 class="levelhead">\' + esc(key) + " - " + groups[key].length + "</h4>" +\n        \'<div class="capgrid">\' + groups[key].map(siteCard).join("") + "</div>";\n    });\n    out.innerHTML = html || \'<p class="muted">No vetted source in that selection.</p>\';\n  } catch (error) {\n    out.innerHTML = errorBanner(error);\n  }\n}\n\nfunction sourceCard(item, web) {\n  const link = web ? item.url : (item.doi ? Object.keys(schema).map((n) => calcField(n, schema[n])).join("")\n    : \'<p class="muted">This method declares no inputs.</p>\';\n  $$("#calcinputs input, #calcinputs textarea").forEach((el) => {\n    el.onfocus = () => {\n      const scalar = $$("#calcinputs input[data-type=\'decimal\']");\n      state.calcFocus = Math.max(0, scalar.indexOf(el));\n      markCalcFocus();\n    };\n    el.oninput = () => { state.calcValues[el.id.replace(/^in-/, "")] = el.value; renderCalcLine(); };\n  });\n  $$("#calcpad button").forEach((b) => { b.disabled = fit !== "A"; });\n  $("#calceq").disabled = fit === "C";\n  $("#calcinputs").onkeydown = (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); calcRun(); } };\n  $("#calcpadnote").textContent = fit === "A"\n    ? "Digits type into the highlighted field. The operator keys move between fields: they do not do the arithmetic."\n    : (fit === "B"\n      ? "This one takes a list or a table, so the keypad is off - fill the fields on the right instead."\n      : "This one runs as a worksheet, so there is no keypad: open it and work through it there.");\n  markCalcFocus();\n  renderCalcLine();\n  renderCalcResult();\n}\n\nfunction renderCalcLine() {\n  const tool = state.calcTool; if (!tool) return;\n  const schema = calcSchema(tool);\n  const keys = Object.keys(schema);\n  const fit = calcFitOf(tool);\n  if (fit === "C") {\n    $("#calcline").innerHTML = esc(tool.label) + "\\n  " + \'<span class="dim">runs as a worksheet - no figures are typed here</span>\';\n    $("#calcunit").textContent = "";\n    $("#calcsaid").textContent = "Open the worksheet to work through it. Nothing is calculated on this page.";\n    return;\n  }\n  const head = keys.length ? keys.join("  \\u00b7  ") : "no declared inputs";\n  const vals = keys.map((k) => (state.calcValues[k] || "").trim() || "\\u2014");\n  const body = tool.label + "\\n  " + head + "\\n  " + vals.join("   ");\n  $("#calcline").innerHTML = esc(body).replace(/\\u2014/g, \'<span class="dim">\\u2014</span>\');\n  $("#calcunit").textContent = tool.method ? "method " + tool.method : "";\n  const empty = fit === "A" && keys.some((k) => !(state.calcValues[k] || "").trim());\n  $("#calcsaid").textContent = empty\n    ? "Fill the figures, then press = . Nothing is calculated until the engine answers."\n    : "Ready. Press = to run this as a recorded calculation.";\n}\n\nfunction markCalcFocus() {\n  const fields = $$("#calcinputs input[data-type=\'decimal\']");\n  $$("#calcinputs .stack").forEach((s) => s.classList.remove("field", "active"));\n  fields.forEach((el, i) => {\n    const box = el.closest(".stack");\n    if (box) { box.classList.add("field"); if (i === state.calcFocus) box.classList.add("active"); }\n  });\n}\n\nconst CALC_PAD = ["7", "8", "9", "\\u00f7", "4", "5", "6", "\\u00d7", "1", "2", "3", "\\u2212", "0", ".", "\\u232b", "+"];\nfunction buildCalcPad() {\n  $("#calcpad").innerHTML = CALC_PAD.map((k) => {\n    const op = "\\u00f7\\u00d7\\u2212+".includes(k);\n    const name = { "\\u00f7": "divide", "\\u00d7": "multiply", "\\u2212": "subtract", "+": "add", "\\u232b": "delete" }[k] || k;\n    return \'<button type="button" class="\' + (op ? The operator keys order the fields; the method does the arithmetic.";\n    return;\n  }\n  const el = fields[state.calcFocus] || fields[0];\n  el.value = k === "\\u232b" ? el.value.slice(0, -1) : el.value + k;\n  state.calcValues[el.id.replace(/^in-/, "")] = el.value;\n  renderCalcLine();\n}\n\nasync function calcRun() {\n  const tool = state.calcTool; if (!tool) return;\n  const schema = calcSchema(tool);\n  const inputs = readInputs(schema, tool.method);\n  if (inputs === null) return;\n  const preset = tool.preset ? state.presets[tool.preset] : null;\n  const body = { objective: (preset && preset.objective) || tool.label, method: tool.method, inputs: inputs };\n  if (preset && preset.currency) body.currency = preset.currency;\n  if (preset && preset.period) body.period = preset.period;\n  $("#calceq").disabled = true;\n  $("#calcresult").innerHTML = loading("Running the frozen method");\n  try {\n    let current = await post("/api/sessions", body);\n    if (current.status === "awaiting_confirmation") current = await post("/api/sessions/" + current.id + "/confirm", {});\n    state.session = current;\n    state.delivery = current.delivery || null;\n    if (current.delivery && current.delivery.status === "delivered") {\n      const recorded = await recordCalcCase(current);\n      state.calcDelivery = current.delivery;\n      state.calcRan = recorded;\n    }\n    renderCalcResult();\n  } catch (e) {\n    $("#calcresult").innerHTML = errorBanner(e);\n  } finally {\n    $("#calceq").disabled = calcFitOf(tool) === "C";\n  }\n}\n\nfunction renderCalcResult() {\n  const box = $("#calcresult"); if (!box) return;\n  const d = state.calcDelivery;\n  if (!d) { box.innerHTML = ""; return; }\n  if (d.status === "blocked") {\n    box.innerHTML = \'<div class="card" style="margin-top:14px">\' +\n      banner("blocked", "Blocked", "<div>" + esc(d.blocked_reason) + "</div>") + "</div>";\n    return;\n  }\n  box.innerHTML = (state.calcRan ? \'<p class="muted">Recorded as case \' + esc(state.calcRan) + " - every number here is inside the audit trail.</p>" : "") +\n    resultBodyHtml(d, false) +\n    \'<div class="row" style="margin-top:12px">\' +\n    (state.calcRan\n      ? \'<button class="btn primary" id="calcopenresult">Open the recorded case</button>\' +\n        \'<button class="btn" id="calcexplain">Download the explanation</button>\'\n      : \'<button class="btn primary" id="calcsaveresult">Save as case</button><button class="btn" id="calcopenresult">Open the full Result page</button>\') +\n    "</div>";\n  const save = $("#calcsaveresult"); if (save) save.onclick = () => saveCase();\n  const explain = $("#calcexplain");\n  if (explain) explain.onclick = () => downloadCaseExplanation(state.calcRan);\n  const open = $("#calcopenresult");\n  if (open) open.onclick = () => {\n    if (state.calcRan) { openCase(state.calcRan); return; }\n    show("results"); renderResults();\n  };\n}\n\n/* ---------- the chat ("Ask instead") -------------------------------------\n   The sentence is sent to the product-layer router, which returns one of\n   five outcomes. "ask" : "pad";\n  const ask = state.calcMode === "ask";\n  $("#calcchat").hidden = !ask;\n  $("#calcout").hidden = ask;\n  $("#calcgroups").hidden = ask;\n  $("#calcgrid").hidden = ask || !state.calcTool;\n  $("#calcmode-pad").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!ask));\n  $("#calcmode-ask").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(ask));\n  if (ask) $("#calcask").focus();\n}\n\nfunction planTool(key) {\n  const d = state.calculator; if (!d) return null;\n  for (const group of d.groups) {\n    const tool = (group.tools || []).find((t) => t.key === key);\n    if (tool) return tool;\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\nfunction planAlternatives(payload) {\n  const rows = payload.alternatives || [];\n  if (!rows.length) return "";\n  return \'<div class="row" style="margin-top:10px">\' + rows.map((alt) =>\n    \'<button class="btn sm" data-plan-tool="\' + esc(alt.tool) + \'">\' + esc(alt.label) +\n    (alt.tier ? " (" + esc(alt.tier) + ")" : "") + "</button>").join("") + "</div>";\n}\n\nfunction planHtml(payload) {\n  const reason = esc(payload.reason || "");\n  const notes = (payload.notes || []).map((note) => "<div>" + esc(note) + "</div>").join("");\n  if (payload.outcome === "out_of_scope") {\n    return banner("blocked", "Not a business calculation",\n      "<div>This calculator runs recorded business methods - finance, accounting, economics, " +\n      "operations, marketing, people and statistics - and it will not produce a number for anything else.</div>" +\n      "<div class=\\"muted\\" style=\\"margin-top:6px\\">" + reason + "</div>" +\n      "<div class=\\"muted\\" style=\\"margin-top:6px\\">If you meant a business question, name the situation " +\n      "(for example: break-even with 1200 fixed cost).</div>");\n  }\n  if (payload.outcome === "unsupported") {\n    return banner("limit", "Business, but not built",\n      "<div>" + reason + "</div><div style=\\"margin-top:6px\\">Closest thing it can actually run:</div>" +\n      planAlternatives(payload));\n  }\n  if (payload.outcome === "choose") {\n    return banner("honesty", "Which one did you mean?",\n      "<div>" + reason + "</div>" +\n      "<div class=\\"muted\\" style=\\"margin-top:6px\\">No calculation has run. Nothing has been calculated yet.");\n      };\n    });\n  } catch (e) { out.innerHTML = errorBanner(e); }\n}\n\n\n/* The Home box is the chat composer (see startChat). It no longer carries method\n   controls: a figure is chosen on a subject page or in the Business Calculator. */\n\nfunction ensurePanel(id) {\n  let p = document.getElementById("panel-" + id);\n  if (!p) {\n    // the panel was removed from the markup by a layout change; recreate it rather than fail\n    p = document.createElement("section");\n    p.className = "panel";\n    p.id = "panel-" + id;\n    p.hidden = true;\n    (document.getElementById("main") || document.body).appendChild(p);\n    if (PANELS.indexOf(id) === -1) PANELS.push(id);\n  }\n  return p;\n}\n\nasync function createSession(body) {\n  const p = ensurePanel("new");\n  state.session = null;\n  p.innerHTML = "<div class=\\"card\\">" + loading("Creating the session") + "</div>";\n  /* The panel is activated, not shown: `show` also runs the renderer, and the\n     no-session renderer sends a student who has no session yet back to the last\n     durable screen.  That bounced a tool opened from a subject page straight\n     back to that page, the re-render pushed the scroll to the top, and the tool\n     opened into a hidden panel.  The card above is what the student should see\n     while the session is created, so the panel is shown directly. */\n  activate("new");\n  try {\n    state.session = await post("/api/sessions", body);\n    state.delivery = state.session.delivery || null;\n    renderNew();\n  } catch (e) { p.innerHTML = "<div class=\\"card\\">" + errorBanner(e) + "</div>"; }\n}\n\nRENDERERS.new = function () {\n  // A worksheet does not need a session: it is rendered from state.worksheet.\n  const panel = ensurePanel("new");\n  if (state.session || state.worksheet) { panel.hidden = false; renderNew(); return; }\n  // A reload has no session and no worksheet; send the student back to the last\n  // durable screen instead of showing an empty "no session" page.\n  const target = lastDurableRoute();\n  if (location.hash !== target) history.replaceState(null, "", target);\n  route();\n};\n\nfunction inputValue(name, spec, plan) {\n  if (state.tool && state.tool.inputs && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(state.tool.inputs, name)) {\n    return state.tool.inputs[name];\n  }\n  const recorded = plan && plan.inputs && plan.inputs[name];\n  let value = recorded ? recorded.value : "";\n  if (value === null || value === undefined) return "";\n  if ((spec && spec.type) === "decimal_list" && typeof value === "string") {\n    const m = value.trim().match(/^\\[(.*)\\]$/s);\n    if (m) {\n      return m[1].split(",").map((x) => x.trim().replace(/^[\'"]|[\'"]$/g, "")).filter((x) => x.length);\n    }\n    return value.split(",").map((x) => x.trim()).filter((x) => x.length);\n  }\n  return value;\n}\n\n/* ---------- the engagement, as a form ----------\n   The engine takes a declarative spec. Asking a student to edit that JSON was the wrong surface: it\n   showed them "prior_closing", "statement.lines" and a wall of braces. This form edits the same spec\n   through the four things an owner actually has - a chart, opening balances, entries, a bank statement -\n   and keeps the JSON underneath, one click away, for the schedules the form does not cover. */\nconst ENG_TYPES = [["asset", "asset"], ["liability", "liability"], ["equity", "equity"],\n                   ["income", "income"], ["expense", "expense"], ["oci", "other comprehensive income"]];\nconst ENG_SECTIONS = [["", "not stated"], ["current", "current"], ["non_current", "non-current"]];\nconst ENG_ROLES = [["", "none"], ["cash", "cash"], ["capital", "capital"],\n                   ["retained_earnings", "retained earnings"], ["oci_reserve", "revaluation reserve"],\n                   ["dividends", "dividends"]];\nconst ENG_NORMAL = { asset: "D", expense: "D", income: "C", liability: "C", equity: "C", oci: "C" };\n\nfunction engClone(value) { try { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value || {})); } catch (e) { return {}; } }\n\n/* The mapping checkpoint, as the table the owner is actually confirming. */\nfunction mappingTable(mapping) {\n  const rows = (mapping && mapping.rows) || [];\n  const checks = (mapping && mapping.checks) || [];\n  if (!rows.length) return \'<p class="muted">The engine returned no mapping rows.</p>\';\n  return \'<div class="tablewrap"><table><caption>The accounts as the engine will post them</caption><thead><tr>\' +\n    "<th>Account</th><th>Type</th><th>Statement line</th><th>Role</th><th>Cash-flow activity</th>" +\n    "</tr></thead><tbody>" +\n    rows.map((r) => "<tr><td>" + esc(r.name) + "</td><td>" + esc(r.type) + "</td><td>" +\n      esc(r.line) + "</td><td>" + esc(r.role || "-") + "</td><td>" +\n      esc(r.activity || "from its type and section") + "</td></tr>").join("") +\n    "</tbody></table></div>" +\n    (checks.length ? \'<ul style="margin:8px 0 0;color:var(--text-2)">\' + checks.map((c) =>\n      \'<li><strong style="color:\' + (c[1] ? "var(--green-700)" : "var(--red)") + \'">\' +\n      (c[1] ? "PASS" : "FAIL") + "</strong> " + esc(c[0]) +\n      (c[2] ? \' <span class="muted">&mdash; \' + esc(c[2]) + "</span>" : "") + "</li>").join("") + "</ul>" : "");\n}\nfunction engFromValue(value) {\n  if (value && typeof value === "object") return engClone(value);\n  if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim()) { try { return JSON.parse(value); } catch (e) {} }\n  return {};\n}\nfunction engSide(a) {\n  const base = ENG_NORMAL[a.type] || "D";\n  const contra = a.contra === true || a.role === "dividends";\n  return contra ? (base === "D" ? "C" : "D") : base;\n}\nfunction engValue(v) { return v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v); }\nfunction engOpts(pairs, current) {\n  return pairs.map((p) => \'<option value="\' + esc(p[0]) + \'"\' +\n    (String(current === undefined || current === null ? "" : current) === String(p[0]) ? " selected" : "") +\n    ">" + esc(p[1]) + "</option>").join("");\n}\nfunction engMoney(n) {\n  return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });\n}\nfunction engTotals(lines) {\n  let dr = 0, cr = 0;\n  (lines || []).forEach((l) => { dr += Number(l && l.debit) || 0; cr += Number(l && l.credit) || 0; });\n  return { dr: dr, cr: cr, ok: dr > 0 && Math.abs(dr - cr) < 0.005 };\n}\nfunction engStatusText(lines) {\n  const t = engTotals(lines);\n  if (!t.dr && !t.cr) return \'<span class="muted">no amounts yet</span>\';\n  return t.ok ? \'<span class="ok">balanced &middot; \' + engMoney(t.dr) + "</span>"\n              : \'<span class="bad">out by \' + engMoney(Math.abs(t.dr - t.cr)) +\n                " &middot; Dr " + engMoney(t.dr) + " &middot; Cr " + engMoney(t.cr) + "</span>";\n}\n\n/* The spec the form would post: blank rows dropped, the opening entry built from the balances. */\nfunction engEnsureCodes() {\n  const spec = state.engagement || {};\n  const chart = spec.chart || [];\n  const bands = { asset: 1000, liability: 2000, equity: 3000, income: 4000, expense: 5000, oci: 7000 };\n  const used = {};\n  chart.forEach((a) => { const c = String(a.code || "").trim(); if (c) used[c] = true; });\n  chart.forEach((a) => {\n    if (String(a.code || "").trim()) return;\n    let code = bands[a.type] || 6000;\n    while (used[String(code)]) code += 10;\n    used[String(code)] = true;\n    a.code = String(code);           // plumbing: the engine keys accounts by code, the owner never types one\n  });\n}\n\nfunction engSerialise() {\n  engEnsureCodes();\n  const spec = state.engagement || {};\n  const out = engClone(spec);\n  const chart = (spec.chart || []).filter((a) => a && String(a.code || "").trim());\n  out.chart = chart.map((a) => {\n    const row = { code: String(a.code).trim(), name: String(a.name || "").trim() || String(a.code).trim(),\n                  type: a.type || "expense",\n                  line: String(a.line || "").trim() || String(a.name || a.code).trim() };\n    if (a.section) row.section = a.section;\n    if (a.role) row.role = a.role;\n    if (a.contra === true) row.contra = true;\n    if (a.activity) row.activity = a.activity;\n    return row;\n  });\n  out.prior_closing = {};\n  out.chart.forEach((a) => {\n    const v = (spec.prior_closing || {})[a.code];\n    out.prior_closing[a.code] = v === undefined || v === null || String(v).trim() === "" ? "0" : String(v).trim();\n  });\n  const opening = [];\n  out.chart.forEach((a) => {\n    const v = out.prior_closing[a.code];\n    if (!v || Number(v) === 0) return;\n    opening.push(engSide(a) === "D" ? { account: a.code, debit: v } : { account: a.code, credit: v });\n  });\n  out.opening = opening.length ? [{ description: "opening balances", lines: opening }] : [];\n  out.entries = (spec.entries || []).map((e) => ({\n    date: String(e.date || ""), description: String(e.description || ""),\n    lines: (e.lines || []).filter((l) => l && l.account &&\n        ((l.debit !== undefined && String(l.debit).trim() !== "") ||\n         (l.credit !== undefined && String(l.credit).trim() !== "")))\n      .map((l) => (l.debit !== undefined && String(l.debit).trim() !== "")\n        ? { account: l.account, debit: String(l.debit).trim() }\n        : { account: l.account, credit: String(l.credit).trim() }),\n  })).filter((e) => e.lines.length);\n  const rec = spec.reconciliation;\n  if (rec && rec.account) {\n    const st = rec.statement || {};\n    out.reconciliation = {\n      account: rec.account,\n      statement: {\n        opening_balance: String(st.opening_balance === undefined || String(st.opening_balance).trim() === "" ? "0" : st.opening_balance),\n        closing_balance: String(st.closing_balance === undefined || String(st.closing_balance).trim() === "" ? "0" : st.closing_balance),\n        lines: (st.lines || []).filter((l) => l && l.date && String(l.amount || "").trim() !== "")\n          .map((l) => ({ date: String(l.date), description: String(l.description || ""),\n                         amount: String(l.amount).trim(), direction: l.direction === "out" ? "out" : "in" })),\n      },\n    };\n  } else { delete out.reconciliation; }\n  return out;\n}\n\nfunction engAccountSelect(i, j, current) {\n  const chart = (state.engagement || {}).chart || [];\n  return \'<select data-eng-line="\' + i + "." + j + \'" data-field="account"><option value="">choose an account</option>\' +\n    chart.map((a) => \'<option value="\' + esc(a.code) + \'"\' + (a.code === current ? " selected" : "") + ">" +\n      esc(a.name || a.code) + "</option>").join("") + "</select>";\n}\n\nfunction engShell() {\n  engEnsureCodes();\n  const spec = state.engagement || {};\n  const period = spec.period || {};\n  const chart = spec.chart || [];\n  const priors = spec.prior_closing || {};\n  const entries = spec.entries || [];\n  const rec = spec.reconciliation;\n  const cash = chart.filter((a) => a.role === "cash");\n  const currency = spec.currency || "USD";\n  const currencies = (state.currencies || []).map((c) => c.code);\n  if (currencies.indexOf(currency) < 0) currencies.unshift(currency);\n  let html = \'<div class="eng" id="eng">\';\n\n  html += "<h4>Period and basis</h4><div class=\\"enggrid\\">" +\n    \'<label class="field">Start<input type="date" data-eng="period.start" value="\' + esc(engValue(period.start)) + \'"></label>\' +\n    \'<label class="field">End<input type="date" data-eng="period.end" value="\' + esc(engValue(period.end)) + \'"></label>\' +\n    \'<label class="field">Currency<select data-eng="currency">\' +\n      currencies.map((c) => \'<option\' + (c === currency ? " selected" : "") + ">" + esc(c) + "</option>").join("") +\n    "</select></label>" +\n    \'<label class="field">Decimal places<input type="number" min="0" max="6" step="1" data-eng="places" data-eng-int="1" value="\' +\n      esc(engValue(spec.places === undefined ? 2 : spec.places)) + \'"></label>\' +\n    \'<label class="field">Framework<select data-eng="framework">\' +\n      engOpts([["IFRS", "IFRS"], ["US_GAAP", "US GAAP"], ["local", "local"]], spec.framework || "local") +\n    "</select></label></div>";\n\n  html += \'<h4>Accounts</h4><p class="engnote">The chart the entries post to. " checked" : "") + \' style="width:auto"></td>\' +\n      \'<td><button class="rm" type="button" data-eng-remove="account" data-i="\' + i + \'" title="Remove account">&times;</button></td>\' +\n      "</tr>";\n  });\n  html += "</tbody></table></div>" +\n    \'<div class="row" style="margin-top:6px"><button class="btn sm" type="button" data-eng-add="account">Add an account</button></div>\';\n\n  html += \'<h4>Opening balances</h4><p class="engnote">The balance on each account at the start of the period, \' +\n    "on its natural side (a contra account is on the other side). The opening entry is built from these, so it " +\n    "always agrees with them.</p>" +\n    \'<div class="tablewrap"><table class="engtable"><thead><tr><th>Account</th>\' +\n    \'<th class="num" style="width:150px">Balance</th><th style="width:54px">Side</th></tr></thead><tbody>\';\n  chart.forEach((a) => {\n    const code = String(a.code || "");\n    html += \'<tr><td>\' + esc(a.name || code) + "</td>" +\n      \'<td><input class="num" type="text" inputmode="decimal" data-eng-prior="\' + esc(code) + \'" value="\' +\n        esc(engValue(priors[code] === undefined ? "0" : priors[code])) + \'" style="text-align:right"></td>\' +\n      "<td>" + (engSide(a) === "D" ? "Dr" : "Cr") + "</td></tr>";\n  });\n  html += \'</tbody></table></div><p class="engnote" id="eng-open-status"></p>\';\n\n  html += \'<h4>Journal entries</h4><p class="engnote">Each entry must balance. The tick turns red with the \' +\n    "amount it is out by, so the engine never has to refuse it.</p>";\n  entries.forEach((e, i) => {\n    const lines = e.lines || [];\n    html += \'<div class="engentry"><div class="engentryhead">\' +\n      \'<input type="date" data-eng="entries.\' + i + \'.date" value="\' + esc(engValue(e.date)) + \'" style="max-width:160px">\' +\n      \'<input type="text" data-eng="entries.\' + i + \'.description" value="\' + esc(engValue(e.description)) +\n        \'" placeholder="what happened (sale, rent, wages...)">\' +\n      \'<span class="engbal" data-eng-status="\' + i + \'">\' + engStatusText(lines) + "</span>" +\n      \'<button class="rm" type="button" data-eng-remove="entry" data-i="\' + i + \'" title="Remove entry">&times;</button></div>\' +\n      \'<table class="engtable"><thead><tr><th>Account</th><th style="width:64px">Dr/Cr</th>\' +\n      \'<th style="width:130px" class="num">Amount</th><th style="width:26px"></th></tr></thead><tbody>\';\n    lines.forEach((l, j) => {\n      const side = l.debit !== undefined ? "D" : "C";\n      const amount = l.debit !== undefined ? l.debit : l.credit;\n      html += "<tr><td>" + engAccountSelect(i, j, l.account) + "</td>" +\n        \'<td><select data-eng-line="\' + i + "." + j + \'" data-field="side">\' + engOpts([["D", "Dr"], ["C", "Cr"]], side) + "</select></td>" +\n        \'<td><input class="num" type="text" inputmode="decimal" data-eng-line="\' + i + "." + j +\n          \'" data-field="amount" value="\' + esc(engValue(amount)) + \'" style="text-align:right"></td>\' +\n        \'<td><button class="rm" type="button" data-eng-remove="line" data-i="\' + i + \'" data-j="\' + j + \'" title="Remove line">&times;</button></td></tr>\';\n    });\n    html += \'</tbody></table><div class="row" style="margin-top:5px">\' +\n      \'<button class="btn sm" type="button" data-eng-add="line" data-i="\' + i + \'">Add a line</button></div></div>\';\n  });\n  html += \'<div class="row"><button class="btn sm" type="button" data-eng-add="entry">Add an entry</button></div>\';\n\n  const recOn = !!(rec && rec.account);\n  html += "<h4>Bank statement</h4>" +\n    \'<label class="row" style="gap:8px;align-items:center"><input type="checkbox" id="eng-recon"\' +\n      (recOn ? " checked" : "") + \' style="width:auto"><span>Reconcile a bank statement against a cash account</span></label>\';\n  if (recOn) {\n    const st = rec.statement || {};\n    html += \'<div class="enggrid" style="margin-top:8px">\' +\n      \'<label class="field">Cash account<select data-eng="reconciliation.account">\' +\n        cash.map((a) => \'<option value="\' + esc(a.code) + \'"\' + (a.code === rec.account ?
