inputmode="decimal" data-eng="reconciliation.statement.opening_balance" value="\' +\n        esc(engValue(st.opening_balance)) + \'"></label>\' +\n      \'<label class="field">Statement closing balance<input type="text" inputmode="decimal" data-eng="reconciliation.statement.closing_balance" value="\' +\n        esc(engValue(st.closing_balance)) + \'"></label></div>\' +\n      \'<div class="tablewrap" style="margin-top:8px"><table class="engtable"><thead><tr><th style="width:150px">Date</th>\' +\n      "<th>Description</th><th style=\\"width:130px\\" class=\\"num\\">Amount</th><th style=\\"width:90px\\">Direction</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>";\n    (st.lines || []).forEach((l, i) => {\n      html += \'<tr><td><input type="date" data-eng-rec="\' + i + \'" data-field="date" value="\' + esc(engValue(l.date)) + \'"></td>\' +\n        \'<td><input type="text" data-eng-rec="\' + i + \'" data-field="description" value="\' + esc(engValue(l.description)) + \'"></td>\' +\n        \'<td><input class="num" type="text" inputmode="decimal" data-eng-rec="\' + i + \'" data-field="amount" value="\' +\n          esc(engValue(l.amount)) + \'" style="text-align:right"></td>\' +\n        \'<td><select data-eng-rec="\' + i + \'" data-field="direction">\' + engOpts([["in", "money in"], ["out", "money out"]], l.direction) + "</select></td>" +\n        \'<td><button class="rm" type="button" data-eng-remove="recon-line" data-i="\' + i + \'" title="Remove line">&times;</button></td></tr>\';\n    });\n    html += \'</tbody></table></div><div class="row" style="margin-top:6px">\' +\n      \'<button class="btn sm" type="button" data-eng-add="recon-line">Add a statement line</button></div>\';\n  }\n\n  html += \'<details class="engadv"><summary>Advanced: the engagement as JSON</summary>\' +\n    \'<p class="engnote">Depreciation, disposals, prepayments, deferred income, bad debts, revaluations and policy \' +\n    "changes are declared here. The form above covers the accounts, the opening balances, the entries and the bank " +\n    "statement; this box always shows exactly what will be posted.</p>" +\n    \'<textarea id="eng-json" rows="12" class="jsoninput" spellcheck="false">\' +\n      esc(JSON.stringify(engSerialise(), null, 1)) + "</textarea>" +\n    \'<div class="row" style="margin-top:6px"><button class="btn sm" type="button" id="eng-load">Load this JSON</button>\' +\n      \'<span class="muted" id="eng-json-msg"></span></div></details>\';\n\n  html += \'</div><textarea id="in-spec" data-type="object" hidden></textarea>\';\n  return \'<div class="stack" style="gap:4px">\' + html + "</div>";\n}\n\nfunction engRefreshAccountOptions() {\n  const chart = (state.engagement || {}).chart || [];\n  document.querySelectorAll(\'select[data-field="account"]\').forEach((sel) => {\n    const current = sel.value;\n    sel.innerHTML = \'<option value="">choose an account</option>\' + chart.map((a) =>\n      \'<option value="\' + esc(a.code) + \'">\' + esc(a.name || a.code) + "</option>").join("");\n    if (current) sel.value = current;\n  });\n}\n\nfunction engSync() {\n  const spec = engSerialise();\n  const box = document.getElementById("in-spec");\n  if (box) box.value = JSON.stringify(spec);\n  const adv = document.getElementById("eng-json");\n  if (adv) adv.value = JSON.stringify(spec, null, 1);\n  engRefresh(spec);\n}\n\nfunction engRefresh(spec) {\n  spec = spec || engSerialise();\n  (spec.entries || []).forEach((e, i) => {\n    const el = document.querySelector(\'[data-eng-status="\' + i + \'"]\');\n    if (el) el.innerHTML = engStatusText(e.lines);\n  });\n  const box = document.getElementById("eng-open-status");\n  if (box) {\n    const t = engTotals(((spec.opening || [])[0] || {}).lines || []);\n    box.innerHTML = (t.dr || t.cr)\n      ? (t.ok ? \'<span class="ok">The opening entry balances: Dr \' + engMoney(t.dr) + "</span>"\n              : \'<span class="bad">The opening balances do not balance: Dr \' + engMoney(t.dr) +\n                " &middot; Cr " + engMoney(t.cr) + "</span>")\n      : "No opening balances.";\n  }\n}\n\nfunction engRedraw() {\n  const host = document.getElementById("eng");\n  if (!host) return;\n  host.outerHTML = engShell();\n  engBind();\n  engSync();\n}\n\nfunction engAdd(kind, i) {\n  const spec = state.engagement;\n  const chart = spec.chart || (spec.chart = []);\n  const first = (chart[0] || {}).code || "";\n  if (kind === "account") chart.push({ code: "", name: "", type: "expense", line: "", section: "" });\n  if (kind === "entry") {\n    spec.entries = spec.entries || [];\n    spec.entries.push({ date: (spec.period || {}).start || "", description: "",\n                        lines: [{ account: first, debit: "" }, { account: first, credit: "" }] });\n  }\n  if (kind === "line") {\n    const entry = spec.entries[i]; entry.lines = entry.lines || [];\n    entry.lines.push({ account: first, debit: "" });\n  }\n  if (kind === "recon-line") {\n    const st = ((spec.reconciliation || {}).statement) || {};\n    st.lines = st.lines || [];\n    st.lines.push({ date: (spec.period || {}).end || "", description: "", amount: "", direction: "in" });\n    spec.reconciliation.statement = st;\n  }\n  engRedraw();\n}\n\nfunction engRemove(kind, i, j) {\n  const spec = state.engagement;\n  if (kind === "account") {\n    const code = ((spec.chart || [])[i] || {}).code;\n    (spec.chart || []).splice(i, 1);\n    if (code && spec.prior_closing) delete spec.prior_closing[code];\n  }\n  if (kind === "entry") (spec.entries || []).splice(i, 1);\n  if (kind === "line") ((spec.entries || [])[i].lines || []).splice(j, 1);\n  if (kind === "recon-line") (((spec.reconciliation || {}).statement || {}).lines || []).splice(i, 1);\n  engRedraw();\n}\n\nfunction engBind() {\n  const host = document.getElementById("eng");\n  if (!host) return;\n  const setPath = (path, value) => {\n    const parts = path.split(".");\n    let node = state.engagement;\n    for (let k = 0; k < parts.length - 1; k++) {\n      const key = parts[k];\n      if (node[key] === undefined || node[key] === null || typeof node[key] !== "object")\n        node[key] = /^\\d+$/.test(parts[k + 1]) ? [] : {};\n      node = node[key];\n    }\n    node[parts[parts.length - 1]] = value;\n  };\n  const edit = (ev) => {\n    const el = ev.target;\n    if (el.dataset.eng && /^chart\\.\\d+\\.type$/.test(el.dataset.eng)) {\n      const i = Number(el.dataset.eng.split(".")[1]);\n      const account = state.engagement.chart[i];\n      account.type = el.value;\n      const band = String({ asset: 1, liability: 2, equity: 3, income: 4, expense: 5, oci: 7 }[account.type] || 6);\n      if (account.code && String(account.code)[0] !== band) delete account.code;   // let it take a code in its own band\n      engRedraw();\n      return;\n    }\n    if (el.dataset.eng && /^chart\\.\\d+\\.name$/.test(el.dataset.eng)) {\n      const parts = el.dataset.eng.split(".");\n      state.engagement.chart[Number(parts[1])].name = el.value;\n      engSync();\n      engRefreshAccountOptions();\n      return;\n    }\n    if (el.dataset.eng) {\n      setPath(el.dataset.eng, el.dataset.engBool ? el.checked : (el.dataset.engInt ? Number(el.value) : el.value));\n      engSync();\n      return;\n    }\n    if (el.dataset.engPrior) {\n      state.engagement.prior_closing = state.engagement.prior_closing || {};\n      state.engagement.prior_closing[el.dataset.engPrior] = el.value;\n      engSync();\n      return;\n    }\n    if (el.dataset.engLine) {\n      const pair = el.dataset.engLine.split(".").map(Number);\n      const entry = state.engagement.entries[pair[0]];\n      const line = entry.lines[pair[1]] || (entry.lines[pair[1]] = {});\n      const field = el.dataset.field;\n      if (field === "account") line.account = el.value;\n      else if (field === "side") {\n        const amount = line.debit !== undefined ? line.debit : (line.credit !== undefined ? line.credit : "");\n        delete line.debit; delete line.credit;\n        if (String(amount).trim() !== "") line[el.value === "D" ? "debit" : "credit"] = String(amount);\n      } else {\n        const useDebit = line.debit !== undefined;\n        delete line.debit; delete line.credit;\n        if (String(el.value).trim() !== "") line[useDebit ? "debit" : "credit"] = el.value;\n      }\n      engSync();\n      return;\n    }\n    if (el.dataset.engRec) {\n      const st = state.engagement.reconciliation.statement;\n      const line = st.lines[Number(el.dataset.engRec)] || (st.lines[Number(el.dataset.engRec)] = {});\n      line[el.dataset.field] = el.value;\n      engSync();\n      return;\n    }\n    if (el.id === "eng-recon") {\n      if (el.checked) {\n        const cash = (state.engagement.chart || []).filter((a) => a.role === "cash")[0];\n        state.engagement.reconciliation = { account: cash ? cash.code : "",\n          statement: { opening_balance: "0", closing_balance: "0", lines: [] } };\n      } else { delete state.engagement.reconciliation; }\n      engRedraw();\n    }\n  };\n  host.addEventListener("input", edit);\n  host.addEventListener("change", edit);\n  host.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {\n    const add = ev.target.closest("[data-eng-add]");\n    const rm = ev.target.closest("[data-eng-remove]");\n    if (add) { engAdd(add.dataset.engAdd, Number(add.dataset.i)); return; }\n    if (rm) { engRemove(rm.dataset.engRemove, Number(rm.dataset.i), Number(rm.dataset.j)); return; }\n    if (ev.target.id === "eng-load") {\n      const box = document.getElementById("eng-json");\n      const msg = document.getElementById("eng-json-msg");\n      try {\n        const parsed = JSON.parse(box.value);\n        if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== "object" || Array.isArray(parsed)) throw new Error("the engagement must be an object");\n        state.engagement = parsed;\n        engRedraw();\n        if (msg) msg.textContent = "Loaded.";\n      } catch (e) { if (msg) msg.textContent = "That is not valid JSON: " + e.message; }\n    }\n  });\n  engSync();\n}\n\n/* ---------- records inputs: a table, never JSON ----------\n   Methods that take a list of records (products, options, observations) declare their fields in the\n   input schema. Render them as a table with one row per record: the student fills cells, not braces. */\nfunction humanKey(key) {\n  return String(key || "").replace(/_/g, " ").replace(/\\b\\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());\n}\n\n/* Check ids are engine vocabulary; the work plan says what will be checked, in words. */\nconst CHECK_LABELS = {\n  trial_balance_debits_equal_credits: "the trial balance debits equal its credits",\n  assets_equal_liabilities_plus_equity: "assets equal liabilities plus equity",\n  net_income_agrees_across_routes: "net income agrees across the routes that compute it",\n  opening_balances_equal_prior_closing: "the opening balances equal the prior closing balances",\n  statement_lines_foot_to_totals: "every statement line foots to its total",\n  journal_hash_chain_intact: "the journal\'s hash chain is intact",\n  cash_flow_agrees_across_routes: "the cash flow agrees across its two routes",\n  retained_earnings_rollforward: "the retained-earnings rollforward ties",\n  income_expense_and_dividends_zero_after_closing: "income, expense and dividend accounts are zero after closing",\n  statement_internally_consistent: "the statements are internally consistent",\n  opening_balances_agree: "the opening balances agree with the ledger",\n  second_implementation_agrees: "a second implementation gives the same result",\n  boundary_zero_rate_equals_sum: "at a zero rate the result equals the sum",\n  t0_cash_flow_shifts_npv_one_for_one: "a shift at t0 moves the result one for one"\n};\nfunction checkLabel(id) {\n  const key = String(id || "");\n  if (CHECK_LABELS[key]) return CHECK_LABELS[key];\n  return key.replace(/_/g, " ").replace(/^./, (c) => c.toUpperCase()) || "a check";\n}\n\n/* What the engine recorded, in a sentence rather than a Python dict. */\nfunction recordedSummary(plan) {\n  const inputs = plan.inputs || {};\n  const keys = Object.keys(inputs);\n  if (keys.length === 1 && keys[0] === "spec" && plan.method === "management_accounts" && state.engagement) {\n    const e = state.engagement;\n    const period = e.period || {};\n    const chart = e.chart || [];\n    const entries = e.entries || [];\n    const rec = e.reconciliation && e.reconciliation.statement;\n    const bits = [];\n    if (period.start && period.end) bits.push(esc(period.start + " to " + period.end));\n    if (e.currency) bits.push(esc(e.currency));\n    if (e.places !== undefined && e.places !== null && e.places !== "") bits.push(esc(String(e.places)) + " decimal places");\n    if (chart.length) bits.push(chart.length + " accounts");\n    if (entries.length) bits.push(entries.length + " journal entries");\n    if (rec) bits.push("a bank statement with " + ((rec.lines || []).length) + " lines");\n    return bits.join(" &middot; ") || "nothing but defaults";\n  }\n  return keys.map((k) => {\n    const raw = inputs[k] && inputs[k].value;\n    const text = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw.join(", ")\n      : (raw && typeof raw === "object" ? JSON.stringify(raw) : String(raw === undefined || raw === null ? "" : raw));\n    return "<strong>" + esc(humanKey(k)) + "</strong> " + esc(text.length > 160 ? text.slice(0, 157) + "..." : text);\n  }).join("<br>");\n}\n\nfunction recordedRaw(plan) {\n  const inputs = plan.inputs || {};\n  const out = {};\n  Object.keys(inputs).forEach((k) => {\n    out[k] = { provenance: inputs[k] && inputs[k].provenance, value: inputs[k] && inputs[k].value };\n  });\n  return JSON.stringify(out, null, 1);\n}\n\nfunction recordsShell(name, spec) {\n  const fields = spec.fields || {};\n  const keys = Object.keys(fields);\n  const rows = state.records[name] || [];\n  const min = spec.min_items || 1;\n  let html = \'<div class="rec" data-records="\' + esc(name) + \'"><div class="tablewrap"><table class="engtable"><thead><tr>\';\n  keys.forEach((k) => {\n    html += \'<th\' + (fields[k] === "decimal" ? \' class="num" style="text-align:right"\' : "") + ">" + esc(humanKey(k)) + "</th>";\n  });\n  html += \'<th style="width:26px"></th></tr></thead><tbody>\';\n  rows.forEach((row, i) => {\n    html += "<tr>";\n    keys.forEach((k) => {\n      const numeric = fields[k] === "decimal";\n      html += "<td><input type=\\"text\\"" + (numeric ? \' inputmode="decimal" class="num" style="text-align:right"\' : "") +\n        \' data-rec="\' + esc(name) + \'" data-row="\' + i + \'" data-key="\' + esc(k) + \'" value="\' +\n        esc(row[k] === undefined || row[k] === null ? "" : row[k]) + \'"></td>\';\n    });\n    html += \'<td><button class="rm" type="button" data-recremove="\' + esc(name) + \'" data-row="\' + i + \'"\' +\n      (rows.length <= min ? \' disabled title="at least \' + min + \' rows"\' : "") + ">&times;</button></td></tr>";\n  });\n  html += "</tbody></table></div><div class=\\"row\\" style=\\"margin-top:6px\\">" +\n    \'<button class="btn sm" type="button" data-recadd="\' + esc(name) + \'">Add a row</button>\' +\n    (min > 1 ? \'<span class="muted">at least \' + min + " rows</span>" : "") + "</div>" +\n    \'<textarea id="in-\' + esc(name) + \'" data-type="object" hidden></textarea></div>\';\n  return html;\n}\n\nfunction recordsField(name, spec, value) {\n  const keys = Object.keys(spec.fields || {});\n  const rows = Array.isArray(value) ? engClone(value) : [];\n  const min = Math.max(1, spec.min_items || 1);\n  while (rows.length < min) { const blank = {}; keys.forEach((k) => { blank[k] = ""; }); rows.push(blank); }\n  state.records = state.records || {};\n  state.recSpecs = state.recSpecs || {};\n  state.records[name] = rows;\n  state.recSpecs[name] = spec;\n  return \'<div class="stack" style="gap:4px;grid-column:1/-1"><label class="field">\' + esc(humanKey(name)) +\n    \' <span class="muted">\' + esc(spec.desc || "") + "</span></label>" + recordsShell(name, spec) + "</div>";\n}\n\nfunction bindRecords(name) {\n  const box = document.querySelector(\'[data-records="\' + esc(name) + \'"]\');\n  if (!box) return;\n  const sync = () => {\n    const rows = (state.records[name] || []).filter((r) =>\n      Object.keys(r).some((k) => String(r[k] === undefined || r[k] === null ? "" : r[k]).trim() !== ""));\n    const hidden = document.getElementById("in-" + name);\n    if (hidden) hidden.value = JSON.stringify(rows);\n  };\n  const redraw = () => {\n    const host = document.querySelector(\'[data-records="\' + esc(name) + \'"]\');\n    host.outerHTML = recordsShell(name, state.recSpecs[name]);\n    bindRecords(name);\n  };\n  box.addEventListener("input", (ev) => {\n    const el = ev.target;\n    if (!el.dataset.rec) return;\n    state.records[name][Number(el.dataset.row)][el.dataset.key] = el.value;\n    sync();\n  });\n  box.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {\n    const add = ev.target.closest("[data-recadd]");\n    const rm = ev.target.closest("[data-recremove]");\n    if (add) {\n      const rows = state.records[name];\n      const blank = {};\n      Object.keys(rows[0] || {}).forEach((k) => { blank[k] = ""; });\n      rows.push(blank);\n      redraw();\n      return;\n    }\n    if (rm && !rm.disabled) {\n      state.records[name].splice(Number(rm.dataset.row), 1);\n      redraw();\n    }\n  });\n  sync();\n}\n\n/* What the page is for and how to work it, in the page itself rather than in a manual. */\nfunction guideCard() {\n  return \'<details class="card guide" open><summary>How this page works</summary>\' +\n    \'<p class="sub">It builds a set of management accounts from what you declare: the accounts you keep, the \' +\n    "balances you start with, the entries you post, and - if you have one - the bank statement to reconcile. The " +\n    "engine posts every entry, closes the period, and produces a trial balance, the statements, the reconciliation " +\n    "and the checks that prove they tie.</p>" +\n    \'<ol class="guidesteps">\' +\n    "<li><strong>Set the period and the currency.</strong> They bound every entry.</li>" +\n    "<li><strong>Check the accounts and the opening balances.</strong> The opening entry is built from the balances, " +\n    "so the two cannot disagree.</li>" +\n    "<li><strong>Add each journal entry.</strong> The tick on the entry turns red with the amount it is out by; fix " +\n    "it before running.</li>" +\n    "<li><strong>Add the bank statement</strong> if you have one. The engine reconciles it and reports what is in " +\n    "transit or unrecorded.</li>" +\n    "<li><strong>Run it, confirm the account mapping, then save the case.</strong> The statements and the workings " +\n    "are on the case page, and the download button gives you the file to hand in.</li>" +\n    "</ol>" +\n    \'<p class="muted" style="margin-bottom:0">Management accounts only: not GAAP or IFRS statements and not \' +\n    "assurance. This is custom analysis (T2), expert review pending.</p>" +\n    "</details>";\n}\n\nfunction provOptions() {\n  return \'<option value="user">my evidence</option><option value="sourced">sourced</option>\' +\n         \'<option value="assumption">assumption</option><option value="synthetic">illustrative</option>\';\n}\n\nfunction materialityOptions() {\n  return \'<option value="">materiality (optional)</option><option value="high">high</option>\' +\n         \'<option value="medium">medium</option><option value="low">low</option>\';\n}\n\nfunction linesOf(id) {\n  const el = document.getElementById(id);\n  return String(el ? el.value : "").split("\\n").map((x) => x.trim()).filter((x) => x.length);\n}\n\nfunction worksheetTextBlock(id, label, prompt, meta) {\n  return \'<div class="wblock"><label class="field" for="\' + id + \'"><strong class="wtitle">\' + esc(label) + \'</strong>\' +\n    \'<span class="wprompt">\' + esc(prompt) + \'</span></label>\' +\n    \'<textarea class="wtext" id="\' + id + \'" rows="3" placeholder="One item per line"></textarea>\' +\n    \'<div class="wmeta">\' + meta + \'</div></div>\';\n}\n\n/* One worksheet form for every framework that has a completion profile.\n   The framework supplies the blocks, the unit of analysis, whether ratings apply\n   and the length bands; this function supplies the same behaviour for all of\n   them, so a new framework needs no new page code. */\nfunction evidenceProfile(t) {\n  return (t && t.completion) || null;\n}\n\n/* What a usable answer in this block contains, and the question that unblocks a\n   student staring at an empty cell.  Teaching text only: it sits beside the input,\n   it is never written into the textarea, and it can never become an item - so a\n   suggestion can never be presented as the student\'s own evidence.  When the model\n   lane reworded the question for this case, it is labelled and shown first, with the\n   framework\'s own question kept underneath. */\nfunction adviceHtml(b) {\n  const advice = b.advice || {};\n  const contains = advice.contains || [];\n  const ask = advice.ask || [];\n  const tailored = advice.tailored || "";\n  if (!contains.length && !ask.length) { return ""; }\n  return \'<details class="advice">\' +\n    "<summary>How to write this block</summary>" +\n    (contains.length\n      ? \'<p class="muted" style="margin:6px 0 2px">A usable answer contains:</p><ul class="advicelist">\' +\n        contains.map(function (item) { return "<li>" + esc(item) + "</li>"; }).join("") + "</ul>"\n      : "") +\n    (tailored\n      ? \'<p style="margin:6px 0 2px"><strong>Answer this:</strong> \' + esc(tailored) +\n        \' <span class="muted">(reworded for your case by the model lane - a prompt, not evidence)</span></p>\'\n      : "") +\n    (ask.length\n      ? (tailored\n          ? \'<p class="muted" style="margin:6px 0 2px">The framework\\\'s own question:</p>\'\n          : \'<p style="margin:6px 0 2px"><strong>Answer this:</strong></p>\') +\n        \'<ul class="advicelist">\' + ask.map(function (item) { return "<li>" + esc(item) + "</li>"; }).join("") + "</ul>"\n      : "") +\n    \'<p class="muted" style="margin:6px 0 0">Answer above in your own words. Nothing here is \' +\n      "evidence, and nothing is filled in for you.</p>" +\n  "</details>";\n}\n\nfunction evidenceBlocks(t) {\n  const p = evidenceProfile(t);\n  return (p && p.blocks) || t.blocks || [];\n}\n\nfunction evidenceBlockHtml(t, b) {\n  const p = evidenceProfile(t) || {};\n  const key = b.key;\n  const fills = { research: "Researched from external evidence.",\n                  quote: "Taken from your own words in the instruction.",\n                  gap: "Only you can state this part. It is never filled for you." };\n  const fill = b.fill || "research";\n  return \'<div class="wblock">\' +\n    \'<label class="field" for="ev-\' + key + \'"><strong class="wtitle">\' + esc(b.label) + "</strong>" +\n      \'<span class="wprompt">\' + esc(b.prompt || "What evidence shows this dimension?") + "</span>" +\n      (fills[fill] ? \'<span class="muted">\' + esc(fills[fill]) + "</span>" : "") + "</label>" +\n    \'<textarea class="wtext" id="ev-\' + key + \'" rows="3" placeholder="One item per line"></textarea>\' +\n    \'<div class="wmeta">\' +\n      \'<select id="evp-\' + key + \'">\' + provOptions() + "</select>" +\n      \'<input type="text" id="evs-\' + key + \'" placeholder="source (needed when sourced)" style="flex:1;min-width:170px">\' +\n      (p.ratings\n        ? \'<select id="evr-\' + key + \'"><option value="">no rating</option><option value="low">low</option>\' +\n          \'<option value="moderate">moderate</option><option value="high">high</option></select>\' +\n          \'<input type="text" id="evw-\' + key + \'" placeholder="why (needed for a rating)" style="flex:1;min-width:170px">\'\n        : "") +\n    "</div>" +\n    adviceHtml(b) +\n    (p.assumption === "probe" && !backgroundProfile(p)\n      ? \'<label class="muted" style="display:block;margin-top:6px"><input type="checkbox" id="evgap-\' + key +\n        \'"> \' + (fill === "gap"\n          ? "I will state this part myself, or record it as a named gap"\n          : "No evidence for this dimension - record it as a named gap") + "</label>"\n      : "") +\n    "</div>";\n}\n\nfunction backgroundProfile(p) {\n  return Boolean(p && p.assumption === "probe" && (p.blocks || []).length &&\n    (p.blocks || []).every((b) => (b.fill || "research") === "research"));\n}\n\nfunction evidenceWorksheetForm(t) {\n  const p = evidenceProfile(t) || {};\n  const unit = p.unit || {};\n  const lengths = p.lengths || [{ key: "short", label: "Short (600-1,200 words)" },\n                                { key: "mid", label: "Mid (1,200-2,500 words)" },\n                                { key: "long", label: "Long (2,500-5,000 words)" }];\n  const styles = p.styles || ["apa", "harvard"];\n  const parts = evidenceBlocks(t);\n  return \'<div class="stepbar" aria-label="How this works">\' +\n      \'<span class="step on"><b>1</b> \' + esc(unit.label || "Name the case") + "</span>" +\n      \'<span class="step"><b>2</b> Write the case</span>\' +\n      \'<span class="step"><b>3</b> Review and generate</span>\' +\n    "</div>" +\n    \'<div class="card" id="evcompletion">\' +\n      \'<h3 style="margin-top:0">\' + esc(unit.label || "Name the case") + "</h3>" +\n      \'<p class="muted">\' + esc(unit.help || "Name the unit this framework analyses.") + "</p>" +\n      \'<input id="evunit" type="text" placeholder="\' + esc(unit.example || "") + \'" style="width:100%">\' +\n      (p.unit_examples ? "" : "") +\n    "</div>" +\n    \'<div class="card">\' +\n      \'<h3 style="margin-top:0">Write the case in your own words</h3>\' +\n      \'<p class="muted">The pipeline researches each part of \' + esc(p.label || t.name) +\n        ", takes what you already said straight from this text, and leaves a part only you can state as a named gap. " +\n        "Nothing is invented.</p>" +\n      \'<textarea id="evinstr" rows="4" style="width:100%" placeholder="\' +\n        esc((t.before || "") + " Describe the case in a few sentences.") + \'"></textarea>\' +\n      \'<div class="fillhint">A good brief covers: \' +\n        parts.map((b) => esc(String(b.prompt || b.label || "").replace(/\\.$/, "").toLowerCase())).join(" &middot; ") + "</div>" +\n      \'<div class="row" style="margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">\' +\n        \'<input id="evname" placeholder="Your name" style="flex:1;min-width:150px">\' +\n        \'<input id="evinstitution" placeholder="Institution" style="flex:1;min-width:150px">\' +\n        \'<input id="evcourse" placeholder="Course code and name" style="flex:1;min-width:150px">\' +\n        \'<input id="evinstructor" placeholder="Instructor" style="flex:1;min-width:150px">\' +\n      "</div>" +\n      \'<p class="muted" style="margin:4px 0 0">These four lines appear on the title page. Leave them blank and it carries the title and date only.</p>\' +\n      \'<div class="row" style="margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap"><input type="file" id="evfile" accept=".txt,.md">\' +\n      \'<button class="btn primary" id="evcomplete">Complete this framework</button><span class="muted" id="evcompletenote"></span></div>\' +\n      \'<div id="evreview"></div>\' +\n    "</div>" +\n    \'<div id="evmap"></div>\' +\n    \'<details class="card manual"><summary><strong>Adjust any part by hand</strong></summary>\' +\n      \'<p class="wintro">Write one item per line for each part. A line can carry its own source as \' +\n        "<code>text || citation</code>, or provenance as <code>text || assumption</code>; otherwise the block selection applies." +\n        (p.ratings ? " A rating is your judgment; it needs a one-line reason. The worksheet computes no overall score." : "") +\n      "</p>" + evidenceBlocks(t).map((b) => evidenceBlockHtml(t, b)).join("") + "</details>" +\n    \'<div id="evbottom" class="stickybar" style="display:none">\' +\n      \'<select id="evversion"><option value="draft">Draft (evidence-led)</option>\' +\n      \'<option value="full" selected>Full paper (model-assisted)</option></select>\' +\n      \'<select id="evlength">\' + lengths.map((o) =>\n        \'<option value="\' + esc(o.key) + \'"\' + (o.key === "mid" ? " selected" : "") + ">" + esc(o.label) + "</option>").join("") + "</select>" +\n      \'<select id="evstyle">\' + styles.map((s) =>\n        \'<option value="\' + esc(s) + \'">\' + (s === "harvard" ? "Harvard" : "APA 7") + "</option>").join("") + "</select>" +\n      \'<button class="btn primary" id="evbottomgenerate">Generate paper (Word)</button>\' +\n      \'<span class="muted" id="evwordscount" aria-live="polite"></span>\' +\n      \'<span class="muted" id="evgate">Every part has content. Generate the paper from these entries.</span></div>\';\n}\n\nfunction swotForm(t) {\n  const quads = [["S", "Strengths", "internal"], ["W", "Weaknesses", "internal"],\n                 ["O", "Opportunities", "external"], ["T", "Threats", "external"]];\n  return \'<div class="wsheet"><p class="wintro">Write one item per line in each quadrant. Strengths and weaknesses are internal; opportunities and threats are external. A quadrant you leave empty is reported as a gap.</p>\' +\n    quads.map((quad) => worksheetTextBlock("sw-" + quad[0], quad[1], quad[2] + " evidence",\n      \'<select id="swp-\' + quad[0] + \'">\' + provOptions() + "</select>" +\n      \'<input type="text" id="sws-\' + quad[0] + \'" placeholder="source (needed when sourced)" style="flex:1;min-width:170px">\' +\n      \'<select id="swm-\' + quad[0] + \'">\' + materialityOptions() + "</select>"\n    )).join("") + "</div>";\n}\n\nfunction matrixForm(t) {\n  const grouped = t.id === "template_strategic_group_map";\n  const raci = t.id === "template_raci";\n  const risk = t.id === "template_risk_register";\n  // A grid names its own axes (touchpoint x stage, service dimension x measure).  The\n  // server sends them in `matrix`, so the form never labels a journey map as if it were\n  // scenario planning.\n  const meta = t.matrix || {};\n  const cap = (word) => String(word || "").charAt(0).toUpperCase() + String(word || "").slice(1);\n  const rowsLabel = raci ? "Activities" : risk ? "Risks" : grouped ? "Competitors"\n    : cap(meta.row_label) || "Scenarios";\n  const colsLabel = raci ? "Roles" : risk ? "Fields" : grouped ? "Two axes"\n    : cap(meta.column_label) || "Drivers";\n  const colsHint = raci ? "One role per line" : risk ? "Four fields: likelihood, impact, response, owner"\n    : grouped ? "Exactly two, one per line"\n    : (meta.min_columns && meta.max_columns\n        ? meta.min_columns + " to " + meta.max_columns + ", one per line" : "Two to six, one per line");\n  const intro = raci\n    ? "List the activities and the roles you have confirmed. Then write R, A, C or I in each cell: R does the work, A owns the outcome, C is consulted, I is informed. Every activity needs exactly one A and at least one R."\n    : risk\n      ? "List the risks, then choose four fields: likelihood (your label), impact (your label), response and owner. Likelihood and impact are labels you declare; no probability or score is computed."\n      : grouped\n        ? "List the competitors you have evidence for, the group you assign to each, and the two axes with a reason for each. Placing a competitor is your judgment."\n        : "List the " + rowsLabel.toLowerCase() + " you have evidence for, then the " + colsLabel.toLowerCase() +\n          " that organise them. Each cell records what you know happens at that crossing, with its source; the grid is your evidence, not a diagram, and nothing is scored.";\n  return \'<div class="wsheet">\' + (t.before ? \'<p class="sub">\' + esc(t.before) + "</p>" : "") +\n    \'<p class="wintro">\' + intro + "</p>" +\n    \'<div class="wblock"><label class="field" for="mx-rows"><strong class="wtitle">\' +\n      rowsLabel +\n      \'</strong><span class="wprompt">One per line</span></label>\' +\n      \'<textarea class="wtext" id="mx-rows" rows="3" placeholder="One per line"></textarea>\' +\n      (grouped ? \'<div class="wmeta"><input type="text" id="mx-groups" placeholder="group for each competitor, in the same order" style="flex:1"></div>\' : "") +\n    "</div>" +\n    \'<div class="wblock"><label class="field" for="mx-cols"><strong class="wtitle">\' +\n      colsLabel + \'</strong><span class="wprompt">\' +\n      colsHint + "</span></label>" +\n      \'<textarea class="wtext" id="mx-cols" rows="3" placeholder="One per line"></textarea>\' +\n      (grouped ? \'<div class="wmeta"><input type="text" id="mx-rationale" placeholder="why each axis, in the same order" style="flex:1"></div>\' : "") +\n    "</div>" +\n    \'<div class="row"><button class="btn sm" type="button" id="mx-build">Build the grid</button></div>\' +\n    \'<div id="mx-grid"></div></div>\';\n}\n\nfunction buildMatrixGrid() {\n  const rows = linesOf("mx-rows"), columns = linesOf("mx-cols");\n  const grid = document.getElementById("mx-grid");\n  if (!rows.length || !columns.length) {\n    grid.innerHTML = \'<p class="muted">Add the rows and columns first.</p>\';\n    return;\n  }\n  const kind = state.worksheet && state.worksheet.id;\n  const placeholder = kind === "template_raci" ? "R, A, C or I"\n    : kind === "template_risk_register" ? "your label, response or owner" : "assumption";\n  let html = \'<div class="tablewrap"><table><caption>What you assume in each cell</caption><thead><tr><th></th>\' +\n    columns.map((column) => "<th>" + esc(column) + "</th>").join("") + "</tr></thead><tbody>";\n  rows.forEach((row, r) => {\n    html += "<tr><th>" + esc(row) + "</th>" + columns.map((column, c) =>\n      \'<td><input type="text" id="mx-cell-\' + r + "-" + c + \'" placeholder="\' + placeholder + \'"></td>\').join("") + "</tr>";\n  });\n  grid.innerHTML = html + "</tbody></table></div>";\n}\n\nfunction vrioResourceCard(n) {\n  const questions = [["valuable", "V - Valuable"], ["rare", "R - Rare"],\n                     ["costly_to_imitate", "I - Costly to imitate"], ["organized", "O - Organized to capture value"]];\n  return \'<div class="wblock" data-vrio-resource="\' + n + \'">\' +\n    \'<div class="wmeta"><input type="text" id="vr-name-\' + n + \'" placeholder="Resource or capability" style="flex:1">\' +\n      \'<select id="vr-prov-\' + n + \'">\' + provOptions() + "</select>" +\n      \'<input type="text" id="vr-src-\' + n + \'" placeholder="source (needed when sourced)" style="flex:1"></div>\' +\n    questions.map((pair) =>\n      \'<div class="wmeta" style="margin-top:8px"><strong style="min-width:190px">\' + esc(pair[1]) + "</strong>" +\n        \'<select id="vr-\' + pair[0] + "-" + n + \'"><option value="yes">yes</option><option value="no">no</option>\' +\n        \'<option value="unsure">unsure</option></select>\' +\n        \'<input type="text" id="vr-ev-\' + pair[0] + "-" + n + \'" placeholder="evidence for this answer" style="flex:1"></div>\'\n    ).join("") +\n    \'<div class="wmeta" style="margin-top:8px"><input type="text" id="vr-conc-\' + n +\n      \'" placeholder="your conclusion (optional)" style="flex:1"></div></div>\';\n}\n\nfunction vrioForm(t) {\n  return \'<div class="wsheet"><p class="wintro">For each resource, answer the four questions with your own judgment, add the evidence behind each answer, and state your conclusion. The worksheet derives no verdict.</p>\' +\n    \'<div id="vrio-resources"></div>\' +\n    \'<div class="row"><button class="btn sm" type="button" id="vrio-add">Add another resource</button></div></div>\';\n}\n\nfunction evidenceGateOpen(t) {\n  // Owner instruction: not every field needs a source.  On a probe profile a\n  // field without one is written as general background by the full paper and as\n  // a named gap by the draft, so nothing blocks.  A student-supplied profile\n  // keeps its acknowledgement gate.\n  const profile = evidenceProfile(t) || {};\n  const blocks = evidenceBlocks(t);\n  if (profile.assumption === "probe" && blocks.every((b) => (b.fill || "research") === "research")) return true;\n  return blocks.every((b) => {\n    const area = document.getElementById("ev-" + b.key);\n    const filled = area && area.value.split("\\n").some((line) => line.trim());\n    if (filled) return true;\n    const gap = document.getElementById("evgap-" + b.key);\n    return Boolean(gap && gap.checked);\n  });\n}\n\nfunction evidenceWaiting(t) {\n  const reviewed = ((state.evCompletion || {}).blocks) || [];\n  return evidenceBlocks(t).filter((b) => {\n    const area = document.getElementById("ev-" + b.key);\n    if (area && area.value.split("\\n").some((line) => line.trim())) return false;\n    const gap = document.getElementById("evgap-" + b.key);\n    if (gap && gap.checked) return false;\n    // A part the review has items for is not a gap; it is waiting to be applied.\n    const part = reviewed.find((item) => item.key === b.key);\n    if (part && (part.items || []).length) return false;\n    return true;\n  }).map((b) => b.label);\n}\n\nfunction refreshEvidenceGenerate(t) {\n  const box = document.getElementById("evbottom");\n  if (!box || !t) return false;\n  const open = evidenceGateOpen(t);\n  // The row is never hidden: a hidden button with a hidden reason is how\n  // "there is no Generate paper button" happened.  It stays on screen and is\n  // disabled, with the open parts named beside it.\n  box.style.display = "flex";\n  const waiting = evidenceWaiting(t);\n  const generate = document.getElementById("evbottomgenerate");\n  if (generate) generate.disabled = !open;\n  const gate = document.getElementById("evgate");\n  const probe = (evidenceProfile(t) || {}).assumption === "probe";\n  const backgroundMode = probe && evidenceBlocks(t).every((b) => (b.fill || "research") === "research");\n  if (gate) gate.textContent = waiting.length\n    ? (backgroundMode\n        ? "No source for " + waiting.join(", ") + ". The full paper writes general background for it (uncited); the draft names the gap."\n        : "Still open: " + waiting.join(", ") + ". Add an item, or tick its \'record it as a named gap\' box.")\n    : "Every part has content or an acknowledged gap. Generate the paper from these entries.";\n  const note = document.getElementById("evcompletenote");\n  if (note && !open) {\n    note.textContent = "Still open: " + waiting.join(", ") +\n      ". A line carrying a number is left out and\n   the caption says how many, so a shorter picture is never read as complete. */\nasync function renderEvidenceMap(t) {\n  const box = document.getElementById("evmap");\n  if (!box) return;\n  const result = state.evCompletion;\n  if (!result || !result.template) return;\n  const blocks = (result.blocks || []).map((block) => ({\n    key: block.key, label: block.label,\n    items: block.items.filter((item) => {\n      const area = document.getElementById("ev-" + block.key);\n      return area && area.value.includes(item.text);\n    })\n  }));\n  try {\n    const map = await post("/api/cases/worksheets/map", {\n      completion: { template: result.template, unit: result.unit, blocks: blocks }\n    });\n    if (!map.drawn) { box.innerHTML = ""; return; }\n    box.innerHTML = \'<div class="card mapcard"><h3 style="margin-top:0">Your map, as you declared it</h3>\' +\n      \'<p class="muted">\' + esc(map.process ? Write one link per line as FROM -&gt; TO, using the item references shown below. A link is your claim about how two items relate; it is not a test.</p>\' +\n      \'<textarea class="wtext" id="wlinks" rows="2" spellcheck="false" placeholder="B1_1 -> B2_1"></textarea>\' +\n      \'<p class="whint">Item references: \' + t.blocks.map((b) => esc(b.prefix) + "1, " + esc(b.prefix) + "2, ...").join("; ") + "</p>" +\n    "</details></div>";\n}\n\nfunction collectEvidenceInputs(t, allowEmpty) {\n  const profile = evidenceProfile(t) || {};\n  const evidence = [], ratings = {}, acknowledged = [], canvasBlocks = {};\n  for (const b of evidenceBlocks(t)) {\n    const key = b.key;\n    const provenance = ((document.getElementById("evp-" + key) || {}).value) || "user";\n    const source = (((document.getElementById("evs-" + key) || {}).value) || "").trim();\n    const lines = linesOf("ev-" + key);\n    canvasBlocks[key] = [];\n    for (const line of lines) {\n      const parts = line.split("||").map((part) => part.trim());\n      let text = line.trim(), itemProvenance = provenance, itemSource = source;\n      if (parts.length >= 3) {\n        text = parts[0]; itemProvenance = parts[1]; itemSource = parts.slice(2).join(" || ");\n      } else if (parts.length === 2) {\n        text = parts[0];\n        // "text || assumption" is an assumption, not a source named\n        // "assumption". itemSource = parts[1];\n        }\n      }\n      if (!text) continue;\n      if (itemProvenance === "sourced" && !itemSource) {\n        toast("Add the source for " + b.label + ".");\n        return null;\n      }\n      const item = { text: text, block: key, provenance: itemProvenance };\n      if (itemProvenance === "sourced") item.source = itemSource;\n      evidence.push(item);\n      const canvasItem = { text: text, provenance: itemProvenance };\n      if (itemProvenance === "sourced") canvasItem.source = itemSource;\n      canvasBlocks[key].push(canvasItem);\n    }\n    if (!lines.length) {\n      const gap = document.getElementById("evgap-" + key);\n      if (gap && gap.checked) acknowledged.push(key);\n    }\n    if (profile.ratings) {\n      const rating = ((document.getElementById("evr-" + key) || {}).value) || "";\n      const rationale = (((document.getElementById("evw-" + key) || {}).value) || "").trim();\n      if (rating) {\n        if (!rationale) { toast("Add a one-line reason for the " + b.label + " rating."); }\n}\n\nfunction confirmDelete(id) {\n  openModal("Delete this case?", "<p>The stored bundle and its versions are removed from the local case store.</p>",\n    "Delete", async () => {\n      try { await api("/api/cases/" + id, { method: "DELETE" }); toast("Case deleted."); show("cases"); }\n      catch (e) { toast(e.message); }\n    });\n}\n\n/* ---------- data ---------- */\nRENDERERS.data = function () {\n  const p = $("#panel-data");\n  p.innerHTML = \'<div class="card"><h2>Data ingestion (structured files)</h2>\' +\n    \'<p class="sub">Read a CSV/TSV or XLSX file into a typed table with a provenance pointer. \' +\n    "Post the file to <code>/api/ingest</code>. PDF, scans and SPSS files are refused: " +\n    "<strong>no PDF text extraction or OCR</strong> is implemented.</p>" +\n    \'<div class="row"><input type="file" id="ingfile" accept=".csv,.tsv,.txt,.xlsx,.xlsm">\' +\n    \'<button class="btn primary" id="ingestbtn">Ingest file</button>\' +\n    \'<label class="field" style="margin:0">Sheet <input type="text" id="ingsheet" placeholder="name or number"></label>\' +\n    \'<label class="field" style="margin:0">Merged cells <select id="ingmerged"><option value="refuse">refuse</option>\' +\n    \'<option value="top_left">top_left</option></select></label></div>\' +\n    \'<div id="ingout"></div></div>\' +\n    \'<div class="card"><h3>Map columns to a method</h3><p class="sub">The mapping is validated by the method itself; the server returns the mapped request.</p>\' +\n    \'<div class="row"><select id="mapmethod"><option value="">method</option>\' +\n      state.methods.map((m) => "<option value=\\"" + esc(m.method_id) + "\\">" + esc(m.method_id) + "</option>").join("") +\n    \'</select><input type="text" id="mapcols" placeholder=\\\'{"value_list":{"values":"amount"}}\\\' size="46">\' +\n    \'<button class="btn" id="mapbtn">Map columns</button></div><div id="mapout"></div></div>\';\n  $("#ingestbtn").onclick = ingestFile;\n  $("#mapbtn").onclick = mapColumns;\n};\n\nasync function ingestFile() {\n  const input = $("#ingfile");\n  const out = $("#ingout");\n  if (!input.files || !input.files.length) { toast("Choose a file first."); return; }\n  const file = input.files[0];\n  out.innerHTML = loading("Reading the file");\n  const reader = new FileReader();\n  reader.onload = async () => {\n    const bytes = new Uint8Array(reader.result);\n    let binary = ""; for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);\n    const body = { filename: file.name, content_base64: btoa(binary) };\n    const sheet = $("#ingsheet").value.trim(); }\n  };\n  reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);\n}\n\nfunction renderIngest(r) {\n  const t = r.table || {};\n  let h = \'<div class="card"><h3>\' + esc(txt(t.filename)) + " (" + esc(txt(t.kind)) + ")</h3>" +\n    kv([["Rows", t.n_rows], ["Columns", t.n_cols], ["SHA-256", t.sha256], ["Delimiter", t.delimiter]]) +\n    \'<div class="tablewrap" style="margin-top:12px"><table><caption>Columns as read</caption><thead><tr>\' +\n    "<th>Column</th><th>Type</th><th>Present</th><th>Missing</th><th>Sample</th></tr></thead><tbody>" +\n    (t.columns || []).map((c) => "<tr><td>" + esc(txt(c.name)) + "</td><td>" + esc(txt(c.type)) + "</td><td>" +\n      esc(txt(c.n_present)) + "</td><td>" + esc(txt(c.n_missing)) + "</td><td>" + esc((c.sample || []).join(", ")) + "</td></tr>").join("") +\n    "</tbody></table></div>";\n  if (t.rows) {\n    h += \'<div class="tablewrap" style="margin-top:12px"><table><caption>Rows as read</caption><thead><tr>\' +\n      (t.columns || []).map((c) => "<th>" + esc(txt(c.name)) + "</th>").join("") + "</tr></thead><tbody>" +\n      t.rows.slice(0, 50).map((row) => "<tr>" + row.map((v) => "<td>" + esc(txt(v)) + "</td>").join("") + "</tr>").join("") +\n      "</tbody></table></div>";\n  }\n  if (t.provenance) h += \'<h3>Provenance</h3>\' + kv(Object.keys(t.provenance).map((k) => [k, t.provenance[k]]));\n  if (t.not_read_as) h += \'<p class="muted">\' + esc(t.not_read_as) + "</p>";\n  h += "</div>";\n  $("#ingout").innerHTML = h;\n}\n\nasync function mapColumns() {\n  const out = $("#mapout");\n  let columns;\n  try { columns = JSON.parse($("#mapcols").value || "{}"); }\n  catch (e) { out.innerHTML = errorBanner(new Error("That mapping is not valid JSON.")); return; }\n  try {\n    const r = await post("/api/ingest", { filename: state.ingest ? state.ingest.table.filename : "",\n      content_base64: state.ingest ? state.ingest.table.content_base64 : "", map: { method: $("#mapmethod").value, columns: columns } });\n    out.innerHTML = \'<h3>Mapped request (as returned)</h3><pre class="json">\' + esc(JSON.stringify(r.mapped_request, null, 1)) + "</pre>";\n  } catch (e) { out.innerHTML = errorBanner(e); }\n}\n\n/* ---------- references ---------- */\nRENDERERS.refs = function () {\n  const p = $("#panel-refs");\n  p.innerHTML = \'<div class="card"><h2>References (optional)</h2>\' +\n    \'<p class="sub">The title and DOI are sent to the selected bibliographic API (<code>/api/literature/sources</code>). \' +\n    "No case text is sent. A citation is marked verified only when the DOI resolves and the title matches exactly.</p>" +\n    \'<div class="row"><input type="text" id="refdoi" placeholder="DOI (optional, e.g. 10.1000/example)">\' +\n    \'<input type="text" id="reftitle" placeholder="Title"><select id="refsrc"><option value="auto">auto</option></select>\' +\n    \'<button class="btn primary" id="verify">Verify reference</button>\' +\n    \'<label class="field" style="margin:0">Citation style <select id="refstyle"><option value="apa">APA 7</option>\' +\n    \'<option value="harvard">Harvard</option></select></label>\' +\n    \'<button class="btn" id="cite">Get citation</button></div>\' +\n    \'<div id="refout"></div>\' +\n    \'<div class="row" style="margin-top:14px"><button class="btn" id="showlog">Show retrieval log</button>\' +\n    \'<button class="btn" id="drift">Check drift</button></div><div id="reflog"></div></div>\';\n  api("/api/literature/sources").then((d) => {\n    const sel = $("#refsrc");\n    (d.sources || []).forEach((s) => { const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = s.name; o.textContent = s.label; sel.appendChild(o); });\n    $("#refs .sub").insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", "<br>" + esc(d.notice || ""));\n    const notices = d.citation_notices || {};\n    if (notices.apa) $("#refs .sub").insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", "<br>" + esc(notices.apa));\n    if (notices.harvard) $("#refs .sub").insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", "<br>" + esc(notices.harvard));\n  }).catch(() => {});\n  $("#verify").onclick = verifyReference;\n  $("#cite").onclick = getCitation;\n  $("#showlog").onclick = showLog;\n  $("#drift").onclick = checkDrift;\n};\n\nasync function verifyReference() {\n  const out = $("#refout");\n  out.innerHTML = loading("Verifying the reference");\n  try {\n    const r = await post("/api/literature/verify", { title: $("#reftitle").value, doi: $("#refdoi").value, source: $("#refsrc").value });\n    state.ref = r;\n    let h = "";\n    if (r.error) h += banner("blocked", "Not verified", "<div>" + esc(r.error) + "</div>");\n    h += kv(Object.keys(r).filter((k) => !["citation"].includes(k)).map((k) => [k, typeof r[k] === "object" ? JSON.stringify(r[k]) : r[k]]));\n    if (r.response_hash) h += "<p class=\\"muted\\">Retrieval audit: sha256 " + esc(r.response_hash) + " at " + esc(txt(r.retrieved_at)) + "</p>";\n    out.innerHTML = h;\n  } catch (e) { out.innerHTML = errorBanner(e); }\n}\n\nasync function getCitation() {\n  const out = $("#refout");\n  try {\n    const r = await post("/api/literature/verify", { title: $("#reftitle").value, doi: $("#refdoi").value,\n      source: $("#refsrc").value, cite: $("#refstyle").value });\n    state.ref = r;\n    let h = "";\n    if (r.citation) h += \'<pre class="json">\' + esc(r.citation.text || r.citation) + "</pre>";\n    if (r.citation && r.citation.notice) h += \'<p class="muted">\' + esc(r.citation.notice) + "</p>";\n    if (r.error) h += banner("blocked", "Not verified", "<div>" + esc(r.error) + "</div>");\n    out.innerHTML = h || \'<p class="muted">The server returned no citation.</p>\';\n  } catch (e) { out.innerHTML = errorBanner(e); }\n}\n\n/* ---------- deliverables ---------- */\nRENDERERS.deliver = function () {\n  const p = $("#panel-deliver");\n  const b = state.caseBundle;\n  const ap = b && b.delivery ? b.delivery.appendix : null;\n  const arts = ap && ap.artifacts ? ap.artifacts : [];\n  p.innerHTML = \'<div class="card"><h2>Deliverables</h2>\' +\n    \'<div class="row"><label class="field" style="margin:0">Case <input type="text" id="delcaseid" size="14" value="\' +\n      esc(state.caseId || "") + \'"></label><button class="btn" id="delload">Load case</button>\' +\n    \'<span class="grow"></span><span class="muted">Exports are written by the server; nothing is computed in the browser.</p>\' +\n    \'<div id="chartout"></div></div>\' +\n    \'<div class="card" style="display:none"><h3>Export</h3><div class="row"><select id="expkind"><option value="xlsx">xlsx (Excel)</option>\' +\n    \'<option value="csv">csv</option>\' +\n    \'<option value="spreadsheetml">spreadsheetml</option><option value="html">html</option></select>\' +\n    \'<input type="text" id="expdest" size="42" placeholder="exports/case.csv"><button class="btn" id="expbtn">Export</button></div>\' +\n    \'<div id="expout"></div>\' +\n    \'<div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn" id="expzip">Download results (zip)</button>\' +\n    \'<span class="muted">A per-case zip export is requested; (labels && labels[0]) : a.metric;\n    const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = metric || id; o.textContent = metric || id; sel.appendChild(o);\n  });\n  $("#delload").onclick = () => openCase($("#delcaseid").value.trim());\n  $("#chartbtn").onclick = renderChart;\n  $("#expbtn").onclick = exportCase;\n  $("#expzip").onclick = backupCases;\n};\n\n/* Client-side Gantt from the same stored values as the server. Deterministic\n   geometry only: no number is derived beyond scaling the stored dates. */\nfunction ganttSvg(spec, values) {\n  const acts = (spec.activities || []).map((a) => ({\n    id: a.id, label: a.label, startName: a.start, endName: a.end,\n    start: Number(values[a.start]), end: Number(values[a.end]),\n    float: a.float ? Number(values[a.float]) : 0,\n    critical: a.critical ? Number(values[a.critical]) !== 0 : false\n  })).filter((a) => Number.isFinite(a.start) && Number.isFinite(a.end) && a.end >= a.start);\n  if (!acts.length) return "";\n  const width = 720, left = 250, right = width - 40, top = 76;\n  const rowHeight = 28, height = Math.max(220, top + acts.length * rowHeight + 70);\n  const horizon = Math.max(...acts.map((a) => a.end + (a.float || 0)), 1);\n  const scale = (right - left) / horizon;\n  const parts = [\'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 \' + width + " " + height +\n    \'" width="\' + width + \'" height="\' + height + \'" role="img" aria-label="\' + esc(spec.title || "Gantt chart") + \'">\',\n    \'<rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#fdfdfb"/>\',\n    \'<text x="24" y="34" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="18" fill="#1b1b1b">\' + esc(spec.title || "Gantt chart") + "</text>",\n    \'<line x1="\' + left + \'" y1="\' + top + \'" x2="\' + left + \'" y2="\' + (top + acts.length * rowHeight) + \'" stroke="#c9c9c4"/>\'];\n  const step = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(horizon / 8));\n  for (let tick = 0; tick <= Math.floor(horizon); tick += step) {\n    const x = left + tick * scale;\n    parts.push(\'<line x1="\' + x + \'" y1="\' + top + \'" x2="\' + x + \'" y2="\' + (top + acts.length * rowHeight) + \'" stroke="#e6e6e1"/>\');\n    parts.push(\'<text x="\' + x + \'" y="\' + (top + acts.length * rowHeight + 18) + \'" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Consolas, monospace" font-size="11" fill="#555550">\' + tick + "</text>");\n  }\n  const positions = {};\n  acts.forEach((a, index) => {\n    const y = top + index * rowHeight + 6, barHeight = 14;\n    const x = left + a.start * scale, barWidth = Math.max(2, (a.end - a.start) * scale);\n    parts.push(\'<text x="24" y="\' + (y + 11) + \'" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="13" fill="#1b1b1b">\' + esc(a.label) + "</text>");\n    parts.push(\'<text x="24" y="\' + (y + 24) + \'" font-family="Consolas, monospace" font-size="11" fill="#555550">\' + esc(String(values[a.startName]) + " to " + String(values[a.endName])) + "</text>");\n    parts.push(\'<rect x="\' + x + \'" y="\' + y + \'" width="\' + barWidth + \'" height="\' + barHeight + \'" rx="2" fill="\' + (a.critical ? "#e15759" : "#4e79a7") + \'"/>\');\n    if (a.float) {\n      const endX = x + barWidth, floatX = endX + a.float * scale, mid = y + barHeight / 2;\n      parts.push(\'<line x1="\' + endX + \'" y1="\' + mid + \'" x2="\' + floatX + \'" y2="\' + mid + \'" stroke="#7a7a75" stroke-width="2"/>\');\n      parts.push(\'<line x1="\' + floatX + \'" y1="\' + (mid - 5) + \'" x2="\' + floatX + \'" y2="\' + (mid + 5) + \'" stroke="#7a7a75" stroke-width="2"/>\');\n    }\n    positions[a.id] = { start: x, end: x + barWidth, mid: y + barHeight / 2 };\n  });\n  (spec.dependencies || []).forEach((dep) => {\n    const source = positions[dep.from], target = positions[dep.to];\n    if (!source || !target) return;\n    const bend = Math.max(source.end + 8, target.start - 10);\n    parts.push(\'<polyline points="\' + source.end + "," + source.mid + " " + bend + "," + source.mid + " " +\n      bend + "," + target.mid + " " + (target.start - 6) + "," + target.mid + \'" fill="none" stroke="#7a7a75" stroke-width="1.5"/>\');\n    parts.push(\'<path d="M\' + target.start + "," + target.mid + " L" + (target.start - 6) + "," + (target.mid - 4) +\n      " L" + (target.start - 6) + "," + (target.mid + 4) + \' Z" fill="#7a7a75"/>\');\n  });\n  parts.push(\'<text x="24" y="\' + (height - 18) + \'" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="11" fill="#555550">Bars are the stored early dates; red marks the critical path, the thin line is float and arrows are the declared dependencies.</text>\');\n  parts.push("</svg>");\n  return parts.join("");\n}\n\nasync function renderChart() {\n  const out = $("#chartout");\n  out.innerHTML = loading("Rendering on the server");\n  const kind = $("#chartkind").value;\n  let spec;\n  if (kind === "gantt") {\n    const metrics = new Set(Array.from($("#chartart").options).map((o) => o.value));\n    const ids = Array.from(metrics).filter((m) => m.indexOf("es_") === 0).map((m) => m.slice(3));\n    if (!ids.length) {\n      out.innerHTML = banner("limit", "No schedule in this case",\n        "<div>A Gantt needs a CPM case with early dates recorded. Run the critical-path method first.</div>");\n      return;\n    }\n    const b = state.caseBundle || {};\n    const repertoire = b.reperform || (b.delivery && b.delivery.appendix && b.delivery.appendix.reperform) || {};\n    const inputs = repertoire.inputs || {};\n    const dependencies = [];\n    (inputs.activities || []).forEach((a) => {\n      String(a.predecessors || "").split(",").forEach((p) => {\n        if (p.trim()) dependencies.push({ from: p.trim(), to: a.id });\n      });\n    });\n    spec = { kind: kind, title: $("#charttitle").value || "Project schedule",\n             activities: ids.map((id, index) => {\n               const label = "Activity " + (id.replace(/\\d+/g, "") || String.fromCharCode(65 + index));\n               const activity = { id: id, label: label, start: "es_" + id, end: "ef_" + id };\n               if (metrics.has("float_" + id)) activity.float = "float_" + id;\n               if (metrics.has("critical_" + id)) activity.critical = "critical_" + id;\n               return activity;\n             }),\n             dependencies: dependencies };\n    const values = repertoire.outputs || {};\n    if (!Object.keys(values).some((key) => key.indexOf("es_") === 0)) {\n      out.innerHTML = banner("limit", "No schedule in this case",\n        "<div>The Gantt needs a CPM case with stored early dates.</div>");\n      return;\n    }\n    out.innerHTML = \'<figure class="chart">\' + ganttSvg(spec, values) +\n      "<figcaption>Drawn in the browser from the same stored values; the server render and export remain authoritative.</figcaption></figure>";\n    return;\n  } else {\n    spec = { kind: kind, title: $("#charttitle").value || $("#chartart").value,\n             series: [{ label: $("#chartart").value, artifact: $("#chartart").value }] };\n  }\n  try {\n    const r = await post("/api/cases/" + state.caseId + "/render", { chart: spec });\n    out.innerHTML = \'<figure class="chart">\' + r.svg + "<figcaption>Rendered by the server from the stored values.</figcaption></figure>";\n  } catch (e) { out.innerHTML = errorBanner(e); }\n}\n\nasync function exportCase() {\n  const out = $("#expout");\n  out.innerHTML = loading("Exporting on the server");\n  const kind = $("#expkind").value;\n  const dest = $("#expdest").value.trim() || ("exports/" + state.caseId + "." + (kind === "spreadsheetml" ? "xml" : kind));\n  try {\n    const r = await post("/api/cases/" + state.caseId + "/export", { kind: kind, destination: dest });\n    out.innerHTML = banner("ok", "Exported", "<div>" + esc(txt(r.path || dest)) + "</div>");\n  } catch (e) { out.innerHTML = errorBanner(e); }\n}\n\n/* ---------- accounts ---------- */\nRENDERERS.accounts = function () {\n  const p = $("#panel-accounts");\n  p.innerHTML = \'<div class="card"><h2>Accounts</h2>\' +\n    \'<p class="sub">Management accounts: a declarative engagement with two checkpoints - the frozen spec, then the account mapping. \' +\n    "The mapping is confirmed before anything is posted.</p>" +\n    \'<div class="row"><select id="acctpreset"></select><button class="btn primary" id="acctstart">Start engagement</button></div>\' +\n    \'<div id="acctout"></div></div>\' +\n    \'<div class="card"><h2>Account mapping</h2><div id="acctmap" class="muted">No mapping yet.</div></div>\';\n  const sel = $("#acctpreset");\n  Object.keys(state.presets).forEach((id) => {\n    const pr = state.presets[id];\n    if (pr.method === "management_accounts") { const o = document.createElement("option"); }\n}\n\n/* ---------- status ---------- */\n/* ---------- check my trial balance ---------- */\nconst CHECK_DEMO_JOURNAL = {\n  period: { start: "2026-01-01", end: "2026-03-31" }, currency: "USD", framework: "IFRS", places: 2,\n  chart: [\n    { code: "1000", name: "Cash", type: "asset", line: "Cash", role: "cash" },\n    { code: "3000", name: "Capital", type: "equity", line: "Capital", role: "capital" },\n    { code: "3100", name: "Retained earnings", type: "equity", line: "Retained earnings", role: "retained_earnings" }\n  ],\n  prior_closing: { "1000": "1000", "3000": "1000" },\n  opening: [{ description: "opening", lines: [{ account: "1000", debit: "1000" }, { account: "3000", credit: "1000" }] }],\n  entries: [{ date: "2026-02-01", description: "capital introduced",\n              lines: [{ account: "1000", debit: "500" }, { account: "3000", credit: "500" }] }],\n  schedules: []\n};\nlet checkJournal = null;\n\nfunction parseTrialBalance(text) {\n  const rows = [], problems = [], numeric = (v) => v === "" || /^-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$/.test(v);\n  String(text || "").split(/\\r?\\n/).forEach((line, i) => {\n    if (!line.trim()) return;\n    const cells = line.split(/\\t|;|,(?=(?:[^"]*"[^"]*")*[^"]*$)/).map((x) => x.replace(/^"|"$/g, "").trim());\n    if (cells.length < 3) { problems.push("Line " + (i + 1) + ": needs three columns - account, debit, credit."); "" : esc(String(v)); }\n\nfunction checkReport(d, det) {\n  const verdict = det.verdict || (d.delivery && d.delivery.report) || "";\n  let html = \'<div class="card"><h2>The verdict</h2><p>\' +   det.cannot_prove.map((x) => "<li>" + esc(x) + "</li>").join("") + "</ul></div>";\n  }\n  return html;\n}\n\nasync function runCheck() {\n  const out = $("#checkout");\n  const parsed =
